stories.title: From history-sheeter to ‘Maharaj’, Ashutosh Pandey:Fake judge signature case; ₹1 lakh to SP over cow smuggling; widow alleges rape
stories.summary: Ashutosh Brahmachari Maharaj. He is currently the subject of discussion. There are two reasons for this. First- getting a case of misconduct registered against Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati through two young disciples. Second- he is a history-sheeter in police records. 27 cases are registered against him under serious sections like rape, cow-smuggling, and fraud. But today, we will learn about the second reason for the discussion. The first case against Ashutosh was filed when he was 16 years old. After this, he forged the registrar's signatures to grab land, and a case was filed in that matter. He forged signatures on the file kept in the judge's room and got a non-bailable warrant (NBW) issued. He formed trusts to seize land. He went to bribe the SP in a cow-smuggling case. He seized a house for a school and then faced allegations of raping a widow. Many such cases are registered. The team of Dainik Bhaskar spoke to people associated with these cases. They learned their side of the story. They examined the FIRs and police actions. In today's Sunday Big Story, we will talk about the cases registered against Ashutosh Maharaj First case at the age of 16 Kandhla town is in Shamli district of UP. Raizadgan area is about 20 kilometers away from the district headquarters. This is where Ashutosh Pandey's house is. His father Rajendra Sharma was a conductor in the roadways. Ashutosh's initial name was Ashwini Sharma. After some time, he changed his name to Ashutosh Pandey. Later, he started writing Bhrugvanshi before his name. 5 years ago, Ashutosh changed his name to Brahmachari Maharaj. Now he identifies himself by this name. In 2002, a case was filed against Ashutosh for the first time. Sections 324, 504, 506 were applied. These sections mean - intentionally causing injury, insulting, and threatening. The police administration periodically releases a list of cases registered against Ashutosh Pandey. The list up to 2019 shows a total of 21 cases registered. As of now, a total of 27 cases are registered. Upon gathering information about Ashutosh, it was found that Ashutosh has filed significantly more cases against other people than the cases registered against him. We spoke to people associated with the major cases registered against Ashutosh. Land seized for school, accused of raping a widow The incident dates back to 2010. At that time, Ashutosh Pandey opened a school in Kandhla. For this, he rented the house of a local widow. He paid rent for a few days, but then took possession. He also stopped paying rent. A dispute arose between both parties. It is alleged that in 2012, Ashutosh entered the house of that widow and raped her. The woman filed a case in Kandhla. The victim's sons live in Delhi. They say - the case of raping their mother started in Kairana. He went to the Allahabad High Court to get it dismissed. He also got a stay. We also reached the Allahabad High Court, presented our side. The court removed the stay. Ashutosh was sent to jail. He remained in jail for about 25 days. We are financially weak, we fought the case somehow. The hearing of this case has been completed. Ashutosh will soon be punished. There is not a single person in the area who would call him good. He only commits fraud. Accused of forming a trust to seize 20 bighas of land Our team spoke to many people in Kandhla. One of them was Tarun Agarwal. Tarun's house is near Ashutosh's. He says - The Ramlila Committee in Kandhla has about 20 bighas of land. This land was donated by people of the Vaishya community. We have been maintaining it for 150 years. In 2008, all of us registered the Ramlila Committee. Then we started moving forward accordingly. Ashutosh did not like this. He started conspiring to seize the land. Tarun says- In the year 2008, Ashutosh applied for registration under a different name. At that time, registration work used to happen here in Saharanpur. Ashutosh forged the registrar's signatures in our registration file. He suspended our committee's file. He also took its certified copy. Taking that, he went to the Allahabad High Court. He said that the registrar had suspended the committee. When this file was investigated, the registrar stated that these were not his signatures. Then Ashutosh's lie was caught. In 2012, the registrar had filed a case of fraud. Tarun says - This person has been very advanced in committing fraud. In 2017, he entered a judge's record room in Kairana, forged his signatures, and got the order sheet changed. NBWs were issued against 3 people. Those three people fled to the Allahabad High Court. An investigation revealed that no such order had been given. This order sheet itself was fake. The judge filed a case in 2017. The Shamli Crime Branch was investigating this matter. Got 25 bigha land registered by lying It was learned from the local people of Kandhla that Ashutosh Pandey increased proximity with Krishnapal Gurjar from the neighborhood in 2006. This was because Krishnapal had 25 bigha land. Ashutosh told him that he would get a loan on his land. You won't have to pay much money either. Krishnapal agreed. On the other hand, Ashutosh made arrangements at the Registrar's office. He told Krishnapal that whatever was asked, he just had to say yes. Krishnapal did the same. He got his entire 25 bigha land registered in his name. When this matter came to light, there was an uproar. Krishnapal filed a complaint with the police. The case ran for 5 years, and then the sale deed was returned. It is alleged that at that time, Ashutosh took 8 lakh rupees. He said that so much money was spent in court proceedings. SP caught him in cow-smuggling through a sting operation Upon investigating Ashutosh's crime history, a case from Gonda was found. This case is from 2012, related to cow-smuggling. At that time, Ashutosh met Gonda's SP Navneet Kumar Rana. He said that a truck loaded with animals should be allowed to pass through Gonda's border. He added, "Currently, the police stop it; we will pay money for this." Initially, the SP thought he was crazy, but later, taking it seriously, he called him the next day. SP Navneet Rana informed the DIG and several other officers about this. A CCTV camera was installed in the office. Ashutosh reached the office at 11 AM on January 24. He placed two bundles of 500-rupee notes, totaling 1 lakh rupees, in front of the SP. All of this was recorded on camera. Police personnel present at the spot immediately arrested Ashutosh. Along with Ashutosh, animal traffickers Ibrahim and Firoz were arrested by the police and sent to jail. The trial of the case is ongoing. He stopped the jailer's transfer with a fake letterhead. Ashutosh Pandey was imprisoned in Lucknow jail in 2008. There, he developed a good relationship with the then jailer, Hemant Gupta. Later, he was released on bail, but the relationship continued. The jailer was transferred. Ashutosh committed fraud to stop the transfer. At that time, the BSP government was in power, and the party's national general secretary, Satish Mishra, had influence. Ashutosh created a fake letterhead of Satish Mishra. Then he made a note and personally went to the department to submit it. The jailer's transfer was stopped. When an investigation into this matter began, everyone was stunned, because Satish Mishra had not issued any letter. Police registered a case against Ashutosh at Hazratganj police station in Lucknow. At that time, CO Hazratganj BS Garbyal spoke to Shamli's SP Dehat Rajubabu Singh. Police raided Kandhla, but at that time, the accused Ashutosh was absconding from home. Escaped police custody many times, carried a bounty of 25 thousand Whenever a case was registered against Ashutosh, he would abscond. Police often raided to arrest him. He has been to jail more than 5 times in different cases. In 2019, Ashutosh remained absconding for a long time in a cattle smuggling case. The administration had announced a reward of 25 thousand on Ashutosh. In Shamli, the administration launched Operation Chakravyuh. Under this, people who had rewards on them started being searched for. On October 2, 2019, Ashutosh Pandey was arrested. Considering Ashutosh's long criminal history, Shamli police made him a history-sheeter. His history sheet number was 76A. Ashutosh joined the Brahmin Yuvjan Sabha. He became the national president. He expanded his cadre in different districts. When the Shankaracharya case came to light, Kanpur lawyer Pankaj Dixit came forward. He had also once been associated with the Brahmin Yuvjan Sabha. Pankaj Dixit says - Ashutosh is a big swindler. He used to extort money from people by luring them with promises of jobs in the SP government. In 2018, we filed a case at Swaroop Nagar police station in Kanpur. Due to his habits, the image of the organization was getting tarnished. That's why he was expelled. Pankaj Dixit says - Not only in UP, but cases have been registered against him in different states as well. CM Yogi and former CM Akhilesh Yadav are urged to seriously investigate this matter. Ashutosh is a cunning criminal. To maintain unity and respect in the saint community, the background of such people cannot be ignored. 'Cases filed during SP government lack merit' Recently, Ashutosh Pandey claimed that all the cases registered against him were filed during the SP government. All the cases are political. When we checked the history sheet, it was found that only 5 cases were registered between 2012 and 2017. The remaining cases were either registered during the previous BSP government or after 2017. Ashutosh was declared a wanted criminal during the BJP government. For these reasons, Ashutosh turned against the BJP in the 2022 assembly elections. He openly started campaigning for the SP. He had started a 'Vijay Yatra' (victory march) to make Akhilesh Yadav the Chief Minister. He visited different districts of UP. Speaking to the media, he used to say - 'On March 10, we will perform the 'Pind Daan' (a Hindu ritual for the deceased) of Yogi Adityanath. Brahmins are united and they are going to make Akhilesh Yadav the Chief Minister. The reason for this is that more than 700 Brahmins have been murdered during the Yogi government. More than two and a half thousand Brahmins were sent to jail by filing false cases against them.' Court has stayed the arrest of Shankaracharya Ashutosh Pandey has accused Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand of child sexual abuse. An FIR was registered against Shankaracharya after the court's order. The Allahabad High Court stayed the arrest. Lawyer P.N. Mishra, appearing on behalf of Avimukteshwaranand, presented some points. For instance, the FIR was filed a considerable time after the alleged incident, which raises suspicion. The young students (batuks) who are alleged to have been raped never resided in Shankaracharya's ashram. It was stated that the victim students are regular students at a school in Hardoi and are currently taking exams. How then could they be students of Shankaracharya's ashram? If two students made allegations, then why was only one student presented before the magistrate? On these very points of the lawyer, Justice Jitendra Kumar Sinha stayed the arrest. The hearing will now be in the third week of March. On behalf of the state government, Additional Advocate General Manish Goyal opposed the arrest stay. However, the judge ignored it. Ashutosh has supported different parties at different times. Currently, he identifies himself as the main plaintiff in the Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi vs Shahi Masjid Idgah case number 4. He also states he is the president of Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi Mukti Nirman Trust Mathura. My life is in danger, I will not fight the case now. We spoke to Ashutosh Pandey about all these matters. He says - "Regarding the POCSO case filed against Shankaracharya, I have only provided information in that case. The rule is also that whenever you get information, you can report it. I will not advocate for this case now. I am receiving threats. False cases are being filed against me. I need police protection, but I am not getting it." When asked about the cases filed against him and being a history-sheeter, Ashutosh Pandey says - "Yes, I have been a history-sheeter. If I am wrong, the police should come and arrest me. Why have they left me out until now?"

stories.title: Gujiya selling at ₹31,000 per kg in Kanpur:Gold and silver-leaf sweets dominate market, dry-fruit varieties in demand
stories.summary: With Holi colours in the air, sweetness in the city is set to arrive in a special style this time. Royal gujiyas coated with gold leaf in Kanpur’s sweet market are drawing customers’ attention. This special gujiya, adorned with 24-carat gold leaf, is priced at ₹31,000 per kilogram. It is the most expensive gujiya in the city. A single gold gujiya box costs ₹750. This festive season, the sweet is offering not just taste but a royal experience. Silver gujiya at Rs 2100 per kilo At Pahalwan Ji Namkeen Sweets in Ashok Nagar, more than six flavours of gujiya have been prepared for Holi this year. Shop operators say that besides gold, the royal collection also includes silver-leaf gujiyas priced at ₹2,100 per kg. Shop owner Gaurav Agrawal said these gold and silver-leaf gujiyas were made on special customer demand. They are especially popular for offerings and gifting. Other varieties include fig, saffron and traditional gujiyas. Healthy taste too, demand for fig gujiya Healthy options have also been introduced in the market this time. Special gujiyas made from dry fruits and figs are being sold at ₹1,600 per kg. Saffron gujiyas, syrup-coated traditional gujiyas and mawa special flavours are also attracting buyers. Increased activity in different markets With Holi approaching, gujiya shopping has intensified in the city’s major sweet markets such as Birhana Road, Raina Market, Panki and Lajpat Nagar. Shopkeepers say people this year are increasingly drawn to premium and unique varieties along with traditional flavours.

stories.title: March to bring intense heat wave:Temperature may touch 40 degrees, Uttar Pradesh likely to face stronger summer than last year
stories.summary: Officially, the winter season is considered over from March 1st, and summer begins to knock. This time, with the beginning of March, concerns about the weather have increased. According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD), this year March could be among the warmest months ever. Maximum and minimum temperatures in northern and northwestern states are expected to be significantly higher than normal. In March 2025, temperatures in many districts reached 35 to 38 degrees. This time, it could be 3-4 degrees higher than that. In such a situation, the big question is, what will the weather be like in March? How much will the heat increase? How much will it affect crops? Read in this report How has the weather been so far? Mahesh Palawat, a weather expert at Noida-based Skymet Weather, explains - Uttar Pradesh experienced less cold this time compared to the last two years. In December-January, the average maximum and minimum temperatures were higher than normal. This time, extreme cold was not observed. Due to La Nia not being active, the cold was not severe. Mohammad Danish, a scientist at the Lucknow Meteorological Center, also states the same. He says - this time, the activity of Western Disturbances remained low in the state during the winter season. Due to this, rainfall was also less than normal during the cold season. How will the weather be in March Weather will change from the first week of March itself BHU meteorologist Manoj Srivastava says - The weather will start changing completely from the first week of March. The summer season will begin. Both day and night temperatures will increase rapidly. By the last week of March, the maximum temperature in many districts of UP can reach 35 to 38 degrees Celsius. IMD's warning about the weather What will be the rain situation in March? According to the Meteorological Department, there is a possibility of average normal rainfall across the country in March 2026. This means that on average, about 30 mm of rain occurs in the country in the month of March. This time too, rainfall is expected to be around this figure. However, the weather will not be the same everywhere. Many parts of the country may experience normal or slightly above normal rainfall. But, some areas in Northeast India and Northwest and East-Central India are likely to receive below normal rainfall. There are also some areas where rainfall is generally very low in March anyway. Therefore, no significant change will be observed there. Temperature remained above normal in February According to scientist Mohammad Danish, the maximum temperature recorded during the hottest day in February 2026 in UP was approximately 29-31 degrees or more. This was significantly higher than the normal February temperature. In Kanpur, on February 23, the mercury reached about 29.6 degrees Celsius. This was reported as the hottest day of the season. This temperature was a record for that time, as such high temperatures are not usually recorded in February. Similarly, on February 24, the maximum temperature in Varanasi was recorded at 31.5 degrees Celsius, which was very high. Meteorological Department expressed concern over crops How will March be for crops? According to BHU agricultural scientist Professor PK Singh, the month of March is considered a crucial time for Rabi crops (wheat, barley, gram, peas). However, the possibility of higher-than-normal temperatures this time has increased farmers' concerns. PK Singh says, "According to the Meteorological Department, temperatures could be 3 to 5 degrees Celsius higher than average. This is likely to have a direct impact on crops. Wheat is currently in the grain formation and ripening stage. If temperatures rise rapidly, the grains may not develop fully. This could lead to a decrease in production." If intense heat occurs prematurely, the crop ripens quickly and the size of the grains remains small. The mustard crop is also in its final stage. Gram and other pulse crops are also likely to be adversely affected by the heat.

stories.title: Burning pyres, ash-covered Naga sadhus play 'Masane ki Holi':Ascetics arrive in Kashi; heavy barricading dampens festival atmosphere
stories.summary: Kashi witnessed a striking and intense scene at the Manikarnika Ghat on Saturday as burning funeral pyres, grieving families, and ash-smeared Naga sadhus came together during the ritual of Masane ki Holi, or Holi of the cremation ground. Naga sadhus and sanyasis celebrated the tradition by applying funeral ashes on their bodies and each other, symbolising detachment from worldly life and the acceptance of death as part of existence. Some sadhus wore garlands made of human skull replicas around their necks, while others danced energetically to the rhythmic beats of the damru. Despite the powerful visuals and deep spiritual significance, this year’s celebration appeared relatively subdued. Authorities had imposed strict barricading at the ghat, and heavy police deployment was in place to regulate crowds and maintain order. Masane ki Holi, a centuries-old tradition associated with Lord Shiva, draws devotees and spectators from across the country, reflecting Kashi’s unique blend of devotion, death, and celebration. Watch the video to witness the rare and intense ritual.

stories.title: 7-Year-old Vaishnavi’s death shocks village:Child with 60% burns dies after week in Lucknow trauma centre; last rites held with abeer-gulal
stories.summary: A wave of grief swept through a village in Barabanki on Saturday after the death of seven-year-old Vaishnavi. Just three days before Holi, her body was brought home, and the entire village broke down in tears. The little girl, with whom the family had planned to celebrate Holi, was instead given a final farewell. Women, children and elderly residents gathered in the narrow village lanes. Every face showed deep sorrow, and many were heard praying that no family should suffer such pain. Vaishnavi had suffered serious burns after falling into boiling water. She was admitted to the Trauma Centre in Lucknow, where she fought for her life for a week. However, she died on Saturday during treatment. In a heartbreaking moment, the grieving family applied abeer and gulal on her face and body before her last rites, as Holi was just days away. As her final journey began, cries and tears filled the air. The last rites were carried out in the presence of police officials. The incident took place in the Kotwadham area of Barabanki district. Now know the full story Sanjay Gupta lives in Kotwadham. On the morning of February 22, his daughter Vaishnavi went to Shivprasad Gupta's shop in the village to buy Maggi. The shopkeeper also makes khoya (mawa) there. Due to this, large pots of boiling water were kept near the shop. Child fell into a pot of boiling water While grabbing the Maggi, Vaishnavi suddenly lost her balance and fell into a pot of boiling water. In the accident, she suffered burns to about 60 percent of her body. Her family immediately rushed her to the hospital. From there, she was referred to the district hospital and then to the Trauma Center in Lucknow. She was admitted to the ICU of the Trauma Center there. Child died after a week of treatment After struggling for life and death in the ICU for a week, her breath stopped on Saturday. Upon reaching the village, the family members, out of tradition and affection, bid farewell to their daughter by applying Holi colors to her. The gulal on the child's face was narrating the story of her unfulfilled joys. Meanwhile, considering the sensitivity of the area, police force and PAC were deployed. The child's last rites were performed in the presence of CO Ramnagar Garima Pant. Mother said - Daughter's room upstairs, no one dares to open it Vaishnavi's mother Geeta Gupta is in a terrible state, crying inconsolably. In a trembling voice, she could only say - Daughter's room is upstairs... no one dares to open it. It's scary. It feels like my life will leave me. That room is still the same today, full of toys. Decorated with colorful clothes and innocent dreams. The mother repeatedly says that this Holi, her daughter will play with lots of colors, she will roam throughout the village and neighborhood. A cheerful, friendly child For the villagers, Vaishnavi was not just a child; she was everyone's darling. Cheerful, friendly to all, she left her mark in every home. Children kept looking for her, and women wept inconsolably in her memory. During the funeral, when people bid her a final farewell by applying gulal, even the onlookers shed tears.

stories.title: Attackers flee to Delhi after stabbing ex-Muslim Saleem Wastik:CCTV tracks attackers for 2.5 km in Ghaziabad; throat surgery done
stories.summary: YouTuber Saleem Wastik, who lives in Loni on the Delhi-Ghaziabad border, is fighting for his life after two unidentified attackers entered his house and slit his throat. He is admitted to Guru Teg Bahadur (GTB) Hospital in Delhi, where doctors say he has multiple knife wounds and remains in critical condition. Saleem had been receiving threats and had shifted to a 55-yard house in Loni about one and a half years ago. From there, he ran YouTube channels and posted videos. For safety reasons, he kept his wife and son, Usman, at a separate house in Ashok Vihar, about 2 kilometres away. Police have formed five teams to search for the attackers. Officers have examined around 180 CCTV footage clips from nearby areas and the Delhi border. The suspects were last seen riding a TVS motorcycle and fleeing towards Delhi. Multiple stab wounds, throat surgery done Doctors treating Saleem said he has 14 knife wounds on his chest, stomach, neck, arms, and legs. There was an attempt to slit his throat, and doctors have already performed surgery on his neck. His liver has also been damaged, and he is suffering from internal bleeding. Another surgery for stomach injuries is pending. Senior police officials visited GTB Hospital and spoke to doctors to understand his medical condition. Police also recorded statements from his wife and son at the hospital. Attackers captured on CCTV near Delhi border Police said CCTV footage shows two attackers on a motorcycle about 2.5 kilometres from Saleem’s house near the Delhi border. Both were wearing helmets. The person riding the bike was wearing a shirt, jeans, and a jacket, while the pillion rider was dressed in a kurta-pyjama. Investigators said the bike was seen using rough roads and moving towards Delhi. Police teams are now searching areas in Delhi and nearby locations to identify and arrest the suspects. Police have also seized the DVR from CCTV cameras installed inside Saleem’s house for analysis. Victim lived alone in isolated house The house where Saleem was attacked is located in a sparsely populated area in Loni. There are empty plots on both sides and no houses nearby. The house has an iron gate and shutter, and a tricolour flag is mounted on the roof. Neighbours said Saleem lived alone most of the time. His wife and son visited only occasionally. A white car with Ghaziabad registration was parked outside the house when media teams visited the spot. A neighbour, Nazreen, said she heard people shouting on the morning of the attack. When she reached the house, she saw Saleem lying injured and covered in blood. “Blood was flowing from his throat and stomach. People said two boys came on a bike, attacked him, and escaped,” she said. Residents scared to speak, fear questioning Many residents in the area were reluctant to speak on camera. Some said they feared police questioning or being linked to the case. A farmer working nearby said the attackers likely planned the attack carefully. “They came early in the morning when no one was around. They must have come with the intention to kill,” he said, requesting anonymity. Another neighbour, Mohammad Zahruddin, said Saleem lived alone and rarely interacted with others. “Breaking into someone’s house and attacking him like this suggests a planned conspiracy. Police should find the truth,” he said. Carpenter Momin, who lives nearby, said he had never seen Saleem’s wife and son at the house. “He lived alone. It was said he ran YouTube channels from his house,” he said. CCTV cameras inside, but none outside Police found that while there were CCTV cameras inside Saleem’s house, there were no cameras installed outside. Investigators believe this indicates Saleem was aware of possible threats. Police said the attackers entered the house and carried out the assault before escaping through the same route. A 14-year-old boy living nearby said residents saw two men arriving and leaving on a motorcycle. He said people gathered after hearing the commotion. Complaint filed against Saleem two months ago Police confirmed that a complaint had been filed against Saleem two months ago at Ashok Vihar police station by a man named Anis Ahmad Ansari. The complainant had objected to Saleem’s online content and sought legal action. Police said they are examining all possible angles, including personal disputes and online activity. Police increase checking at Delhi border Police have increased checking at the Delhi-Ghaziabad border and surrounding areas. Five teams are working to identify and arrest the attackers. Officials said they are analysing CCTV footage, questioning witnesses, and examining digital evidence. Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has said the attackers will not be spared and has directed police to take strict action. Police said the investigation is ongoing and arrests are expected soon. Meanwhile, Saleem remains in critical condition at GTB Hospital.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav calls SP leader Moid Khan after release:Party chief stands by acquitted leader; seeks justice and rehabilitation after jail term
stories.summary: SP leader Moid Khan, who was released from jail in the Ayodhya gang rape case, received a call from party chief Akhilesh Yadav on Saturday. This conversation was facilitated by former minister Pawan Pandey. Akhilesh extended Ramadan greetings to Moid Khan. He said, the party has stood with you from the beginning and will continue to support you in every fight. Akhilesh Yadav has invited Moid Khan to Lucknow for a meeting. The court has acquitted Moid Khan in the gang rape case. He was released on Friday after spending 19 months in jail. In his interaction with the media, Moid Khan had called CM Yogi a saint. He said that some people from my own community misled the Chief Minister. Former minister Pawan Pandey said, Moid Khan has been a victim of BJP government's oppression, atrocities and false cases. The court has honorably acquitted him. Now read the full conversation between Akhilesh-Moid... Akhilesh- Moid ji...Namaste. Moid- Namaste, Chairman ji. Akhilesh- First of all, Ramadan Mubarak to you... Moid- To you too... Akhilesh- From day one, we were saying that great injustice was being done to you. Moid- Yes... yes. Akhilesh- The way things were becoming clear here, it was obvious that injustice was being done to you. Moid- Yes. Akhilesh- But now you are out of trouble. Moid- Media people came yesterday, I mentioned your point, but they didn't show it, they cut it out. Akhilesh- No problem...whatever loss has occurred, we will compensate for it. Moid- When you spoke, only then the DNA came; if you hadn't spoken, the DNA wouldn't have come, I wouldn't have been released. Akhilesh- They caused you a lot of damage, destroyed everything of yours. Moid- Yes, they destroyed everything. They have left us on the streets. Akhilesh-Don't worry, we will call you to Lucknow. Moid- Thank you very much. SP has been raising its voice since day one Pawan Pandey said that since the matter came to light, SP has been registering protests, calling it an injustice. Action was taken due to political animosity. Govt should compensate for socio-economic losses Pawan Pandey said that every person in the Bhadarsa area knew that Moid Khan was innocent. He demanded that the Uttar Pradesh government should compensate him for his social and economic losses. Also, help him restart his goat farming business so that he can return to normal life. Released from jail after 19 months SP leader Moid Khan was released from jail after 19 months on Friday in the notorious Ayodhya gang rape case. He told the media, I had faith in the judiciary. We have got justice. The SP leader said that if CM Yogi's blessings remain, the bakery will be rebuilt. This is a means of employment for our children. POCSO court judge Nirupama Vikram had acquitted Moid Khan on January 29. Now the SP leader has also got bail under the Gangster Act. His servant Raju Khan was found guilty and sentenced to 20 years' imprisonment. Moid's servant's DNA came positive A gang rape case with a minor girl was registered in Purakalandar on July 29, 2024. SP leader Moid Khan and his bakery worker Raju Khan were named as accused in this case. During the police investigation, DNA tests were conducted on Moid Khan and his servant Raju Khan. In the report, Moid Khan's DNA came back negative, while Raju Khan's DNA came positive. After examining the DNA report and other evidence, the court acquitted Moid. Meanwhile, servant Raju Khan was sentenced to 20 years' imprisonment. Moid got advantage on 4 points in court Saeed Khan, the lawyer defending Moid, told a media channel that DNA test results were most crucial in this decision. The court has found Moid innocent and 'honorably acquitted' him. 1. The fetus's DNA test was conducted on the court's order, which did not match with Moid's DNA. 2. The prosecution could not even prove where the incident took place. The prosecution presented a total of 13 witnesses in support of the rape victim. 3. It was claimed that a video was made during the incident, but no video evidence was presented in court. 4. Contradictions also emerged regarding the crime scene in the police investigation. The police investigation made different claims about the incident occurring under a tree outside the bakery and inside the bakery. Bulldozer was used on Moid's bakery and complex After this matter came to light, the administration had also carried out bulldozer action on Moid Khan's bakery and shopping complex. This had created a political controversy at that time. After the court's decision, Moid Khan's supporters and family members got major relief. A 12-year-old girl was raped in the entire Qalandar police station area. It was alleged that the accused made an obscene video of the girl. Then they continued to blackmail her for a long time and committed heinous acts against her. The revelation came on July 29, 2024, when the victim girl became 2 months pregnant. The girl's mother filed a complaint against SP leader (bakery owner) Moid Khan and his servant Raju. She alleged that police did not take action. People from VHP, Bajrang Dal, along with Nishad Party, expressed anger over the incident. After this, the police arrested Moid Khan and his servant Raju. The girl is the youngest among 4 sisters. Her father passed away 2 years ago. The household runs on the wages earned by the mother and sisters. It is alleged that about two and a half months ago, the girl was returning from working in the fields. On the way, she met Raju. He said that bakery owner Moid Khan was calling her. There she was gang-raped, and then a video was made.

stories.title: YouTuber Salim Wastik attacked in Ghaziabad:Questions rise over planned conspiracy, extremist links, and named suspects in murder case
stories.summary: YouTuber Salim Wastik was attacked in Ghaziabad. He underwent surgery at Delhi's Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital. Now, questions are being raised about why there was an attempt to kill the YouTuber? Salim Wastik gained recognition for questioning Islamic practices like triple talaq and halala. He had declared Islam a 'foreign religion'. Investigation has revealed that he received multiple threats. He was told to stop talking about Islam and halal on his YouTube channel. But Salim did not back down. Initial investigation by Ghaziabad police also revealed that this attack was not sudden, but rather a conspiracy planned by extremists. His movements had been under surveillance for a long time. He had started writing 'EX', meaning former Muslim, on his YouTube channel. It is being reported that the attack was carried out because he spoke about the Quran and religion. Let's find out who YouTuber Salim Wastik really is. Read the report... Received religious education, used to go to mosque for prayers Salim Wastik shared his personal life in one of his YouTube videos. He said - I received my religious education from Azad School. My life was very normal from the beginning. I used to go to the mosque with my father and offer prayers. I used to read the Quran as a compulsory subject. In my family, my mother and sisters were more religiously devoted. They were strict in offering prayers 5 times a day. My brother and I were also very religious. But then, gradually, I saw many such practices that should not exist. Women have not been given rights; men did whatever they wanted. That's why I decided to leave Islam. After this, Salim started speaking against Islamic customs. Salim built a house in Alvinagar of Ankur Vihar in Loni. Right outside the house, he set up an office. To reach more and more people with his message, he created a YouTube channel. He named it 'Salim Vastik 0007'. But his real identity changed when he declared himself an 'Ex-Muslim'. More than 30 thousand followers, says - flaws in Islam Salim has more than 30 thousand followers on his channel. He used to say - people in our society are afraid, they don't openly speak about their ideology. Look, there are flaws in Islam, too. Good education is not being provided in madrasas. The financial condition of most Muslims never improves. Why is this happening? This needs to be thought about. Similarly, Salim would express his opinions frankly in TV debates. People believe that this very frankness has now become the reason for the attack on him. The attackers came with intent to kill, stabbed immediately On Friday morning, Salim was sitting in his office. Two attackers arrived there on a bike. They came with a plan to attack, as there was no argument at the scene. They launched a barrage of attacks on Salim with knives. The attackers tried to slit Salim's throat, then stabbed him multiple times in the stomach. A total of 14 wounds were found on his body. After this, the criminals fled on the bike. When people nearby reached their office, the YouTuber was lying on the ground in a bloody condition. He was immediately admitted to Delhi's GTB Hospital. He has undergone surgery. From AIMIM leader to builder under scrutiny Instead of staying silent on this matter, Salim's son, Usman, has filed a named complaint against 5 people. Police have registered an FIR against Bhati Builder, AIMIM leader Azgar, Ashraf, Shahrukh, and Sonu based on Usman's complaint. The family alleges that this attack was not just a whim of two bike riders, but there is a well-planned conspiracy behind it, which is connected to influential people in society. Police are now investigating whether these attackers were given a 'contract' by these named accused? 1 operation done, stomach surgery pending, condition critical Salim Wastik has been admitted to Delhi's GTB Hospital in critical condition. According to doctors, his condition remains concerning. His throat surgery has been successfully completed, but due to deep wounds in his stomach, another major operation needs to be performed today. Now 2 pictures of where Salim currently lives.. Tension in the area after the attack Ghaziabad police have formed several teams to catch the accused. Police are scanning CCTV footage from the surrounding areas to identify the unknown bike-borne attackers. After this attack, there is heavy outrage among people in Loni and the surrounding areas. Meanwhile, the Loni Station House Officer said - The attack on Salim Wastik is a serious matter. We are investigating every aspect, whether it is ideological enmity or any mutual dispute. The culprits will not be spared.

stories.title: UP's most powerful IAS Sanjay Prasad will go to Centre:Alok Kumar among 6 IAS officers added to Centre's list
stories.summary: Powerful IAS officer Sanjay Prasad from UP will go to the Center. Sanjay Prasad is a 1995 batch officer. He is highly trusted by CM Yogi Adityanath and serves as his Additional Chief Secretary (ACS). Besides Sanjay Prasad, Additional Chief Secretary of the Industrial Development Department, Alok Kumar may go on deputation to the Government of India. The Modi government has empaneled 6 IAS officers from the Yogi government for deputation to secretary and equivalent positions at the Center. IAS officers had expressed their own desire to go According to information, applications were sought by the central government for deputation to secretary and equivalent positions. Several IAS officers from the UP government had applied for empanelment. However, the central government has empaneled 1993 batch IAS Alok Kumar, 1994 batch IAS Leena Johri, 1995 batch IAS Mrityunjay Narayan, Santosh Kumar Yadav, Bhuvnesh Kumar, and Sanjay Prasad. Mrityunjay Kumar, Santosh Kumar Yadav, and Bhuvnesh Kumar are already on central deputation. Yogi government's NOC required by the Center The appointment department official said that after empanelment, the Government of India takes NOC from the state government before posting IAS officers. After receiving NOC from the state government, officers are appointed as Secretary or an equivalent position in any ministry of the central government. What happens if the state government doesn't give NOC? The appointment department official said that there is also a possibility that even after posting orders are issued by the Government of India, the state government may not relieve the IAS officer. However, the central government can use its special powers to post any IAS and IPS officer on deputation to the Government of India; in such situations, the state government has to relieve them. Know the Officers... 1- Sanjay Prasad: Born on May 23, 1971, in Sitamarhi, Bihar. Has completed an MA in Geography. Also known as the right hand of Yogi Adityanath. Not only this, but he is also considered one of the most powerful IAS officers in UP. Sanjay Prasad and Yogi Adityanath met in Gorakhpur; at that time, Yogi used to be the MP of Gorakhpur. 2- Alok Kumar: Was born in Mathuramal Tola of Manjhoul Panchayat-1 in Begusarai, Bihar. Father Trivikram Prasad Singh was an engineer. Has deep experience in policy-making, institutional reforms, and public health. As advisor for the social sector at NITI Aayog, he did excellent work in national health policy, medical education, and health financing. He has also served as faculty at Lal Bahadur Shastri Academy of Administration. 3- Mrityunjay Kumar Narayan: Has a B.Tech in Electrical Engineering from IIT Kanpur and an M.Tech in Electrical Engineering. Holds M.Sc. in Public Policy and Management from King's College London. Born on January 1, 1970, Mrityunjay Kumar has been on deputation to the Government of India since August 2019. He is currently the Registrar General of the Population Census. 4- Santosh Kumar Yadav: On deputation to the Government of India since February 2020, he is currently the Chairman of the National Highways Authority. 5- Bhuvnesh Kumar: On deputation to the Government of India since June 2021, he is currently serving as Additional Secretary in the Department of IT and Electronics. 6- Leena Johri: A 1994 batch IAS officer of UP cadre, Leena Johri is serving as Additional Chief Secretary in the Department of Women and Child Development. Proficient in English and Hindi, Leena Johri has held several important positions in Uttar Pradesh administration. Upcoming panchayat and assembly elections in UP, what will be the impact Sanjay Prasad is the Additional Chief Secretary to CM Yogi. Among other IAS officers, he is the closest and most trusted to the CM. In such a situation, there is a high possibility that his name will remain only in the list. The state government will not give NOC for his posting in view of the upcoming assembly elections. If Sanjay Prasad goes on deputation to the Government of India, CMO will have to search for a new trusted officer. Alok Kumar has major responsibilities in the Industrial Development Department. If he goes on deputation to the Government of India, they will need to search for another officer for Industry. Alok Kumar has been in the Industry department for a very long time; if he leaves, the department's work may be initially affected.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:US, Israel attack Iran; over 50 Iranian students killed; Chargesheet against Dr. Rameez at KGMU more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news updates from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top headlines: 1. US, Israel attack Iran; over 50 Iranian students killed Israel struck multiple Iranian cities, including Tehran, on Saturday morning. According to IRNA, over 50 female students were killed and several were injured in southern Iran. In retaliation, Iran launched counterattacks, reportedly firing around 400 missiles at Israel, escalating tensions between the two nations. 2. Chargesheet against Dr. Rameez at KGMU Lucknow police file an 800-page chargesheet against Dr Rameezuddin Nayak and three others, citing obscene videos, victim statements and forensic evidence. He is accused of sexual assault, forced abortion and pressuring women for religious conversion. 3. Slogans raised against former Deputy CM: Brahmin community halts Lucknow address BJP and Congress leaders came together on the same stage in Lucknow today. The Brahmin community organised an intellectual gathering at the Indira Gandhi Foundation. During this, Brahmin leaders from all parties were invited. 4. Blast at Andhra Pradesh firecracker factory kills 20 A blast occurred at a cracker-making unit in Vetlapalem village, Kakinada district, Andhra Pradesh, on Saturday. The accident killed 20 people and left several others critically injured. 5. Rinku Singh’s father’s last words move fans Cricketer Rinku Singh’s father, Khanchand, passed away after urging his son to play bravely and with dedication. His emotional message from a Noida hospital has deeply touched family members and supporters. 6. ₹12-crore Lamborghini released on ₹8-crore bond A luxury car accused of injuring six people is released from a police station after a Kanpur court accepts a bond of over ₹8 crore. The vehicle was taken away on a truck at midnight. 7. EC releases WB final voter list after SIR The final electoral roll has been published in the Hooghly district of West Bengal. According to district administration sources, the number of voters has decreased by nearly 16,000 in the final list compared to the draft roll. 8. YouTuber stabbed 14 times at Ghaziabad home Masked attackers stormed YouTuber Salim Vastik’s house and stabbed him repeatedly, leaving him seriously injured. The assailants fled the scene, and police have launched an investigation. 9. Constable assaults devotee at Kashi Vishwanath temple Police personnel allegedly slapped a young devotee and pulled his hair at the temple premises, barring him from darshan. A female journalist present at the site also reported harassment during the incident. 10. Delhi liquor industry sees strong growth, earns over ₹8,250 cr in FY25 The liquor industry in Delhi is growing rapidly and remains a major source of income for the government. In the financial year 2024–25 (FY25), it generated more than ₹8,250 crore in excise revenue.

stories.title: ₹1,500 crore gas subsidy transferred to 1.86 crore women:UP CM Yogi Adityanath says, 'All people treated equally'
stories.summary: 1.86 crore women in UP received a big gift before Holi. CM Yogi Adityanath released ₹1,500 crore for Ujjwala gas subsidy on Saturday. While extending Holi greetings to the state residents, CM Yogi said this festival is about equality. There is no discrimination in it. No one is small, no one is big. He said, whichever agency has a women's gas connection, they can go there and use that money to get a filled cylinder from there. Yogi said, Prime Minister Modi says there are four castes in the country. One is farmer, women, youth, and poor. All castes are included in this. All communities, paths, sects, religions are included in this. There is only one mantra for everyone to get the benefit of the scheme - everyone's support, everyone's development. The Chief Minister also said Government's job is public service: When a government is sensitive, it thinks about the entire society. In the previous government, everything was limited to just one family. For them, the family was the state, and the family members left no stone unturned in exploiting the state. For us, the 25 crore people of Uttar Pradesh are our family. Ujjwala Scheme started in 2022: The double-engine government started this facility in 2022, before Holi. There are only four castes in the country. Poor, farmers, women and youth. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has worked to connect the poor, farmers, women and youth on a priority basis. 80 crore people getting free ration: 80 crore people in the country are availing the benefit of the free ration facility, out of which 15 crore people are from Uttar Pradesh alone. 1.86 crore Ujjwala beneficiaries in UP: Under the Ujjwala scheme, more than 10 crore people have benefited across the country. In Uttar Pradesh alone, there are 1.86 million beneficiaries. Families who never received gas cylinders before have also now been provided with this facility. Health security for 50 crore people: Health guarantee of up to 5 lakh is being provided to 50 crore people. Free health facilities are also being provided to people above 70 years of age. Shiksha Mitras and instructors will also get facility: Now, Shiksha Mitras and instructors will also be given free health facilities. Those who work for society, the government will work for them. Law and order now better in the state: Earlier governments used to divide society. There was an atmosphere of anarchy. Neither the daughters nor the traders were safe. Curfew would be imposed during festivals. But now it's not like that. All people are safe in the state. Every investor from country and world wants to come to UP: Before 2017, no one even looked towards Uttar Pradesh. Today, every major investor from the country and the world wants to come to Uttar Pradesh. Because they know the government can provide security and also solve their problems by making decisions. Our Uttar Pradesh will benefit from investments coming from Germany, Japan, and Singapore. Subsidy and free cylinder provision under Ujjwala scheme CM said, under the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana, the central government is providing gas cylinders at subsidised rates to beneficiaries this year. Each beneficiary gets a subsidy of 335.40 per cylinder for 9 cylinders in a year, which is returned to their account. Additionally, the state government has decided that each Ujjwala family will be provided one free cylinder each before Diwali and Holi.

stories.title: Slogans raised against former Deputy CM Dinesh Sharma:Brahmin community halts Lucknow address over UGC silence
stories.summary: BJP and Congress leaders came together on the same stage in Lucknow today. The Brahmin community organized an intellectual gathering at the Indira Gandhi Foundation. During this, Brahmin leaders from all parties were invited. BJP's Rajya Sabha MP and former Deputy CM Dinesh Sharma, former Governor Kalraj Mishra, attended. Along with them, Congress's UP in-charge Avinash Pandey and state president Ajay Rai were also seated in adjacent chairs. The organizer, Akhil Bharatiya Brahmin Mahasabha's national president Rajendra Nath Tripathi, said that the objective is to unite society and discuss problems. Today, we are discussing issues like injustice against upper castes, atrocities, and actions driven by revenge. We have sent invitations to upper caste leaders from all political parties. Regarding former CM Mayawati's inclination towards Brahmins, he said that she is only doing politics. United for their respect and security Rajendra Nath Tripathi said - We have gathered here to discuss for securing our respect, rights, and the future of our children. Brahmin leaders applauded when the UGC Act was passed. We should not oppose the UGC Act, but rather such MPs and MLAs. UGC is a scheme to eliminate the upper caste society; we will not let it succeed. Those who are saying that no student will be harmed should withdraw this. The provisions of the Dalit Act were already in place; why was UGC brought in? What was the need for an amendment while disregarding the Supreme Court's order? If someone files a false case, we will go to jail. What is the need for this? 'Brahmin leaders sitting in the house are objects of hatred' It is unfortunate that when the UGC was passed, both the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha were in session, but all the upper-caste leaders were clapping while wearing bangles. Shame on such leaders who deserve the most contempt. Everyone is doing politics. When atrocities were happening against Brahmins, there were Brahmin leaders in the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha. What were they doing? Let us know which MLA or MP raised their voice against UGC. What benefit will society get from the victory or defeat of such Brahmin leaders? 'BJP's strictness on Brahmin leaders is wrong' BJP's strictness on the meeting of Brahmin leaders is very wrong. What's wrong if BJP MLAs themselves sit together and discuss over baati-chokha? MLAs and MPs of other castes also meet at their places. Why aren't restrictions imposed on them? Does it mean Brahmins have become so weak that they will work under their whip? All parties' agenda is 'Eliminate upper castes, persecute Brahmins' What happened with the Batuk (young priests) at Prayagraj Magh Mela is extremely shameful and a grave injustice - this is a sign of decline. Murder anywhere is murder, but when a Brahmin is murdered, it is said that the sin of Brahma-hatya (killing of a Brahmin) will be incurred. Brahma-hatya indeed occurs - watch what happens in the coming future. What is happening with Swami Avimukteshwaranand is unfortunate. The character of Shankaracharya was tarnished by a miscreant; we condemn this. In Modi and Yogi's Hindutva government, nothing could be more unfortunate than what is happening. In this matter, we fully support Swami Avimukteshwaranand and stand with him. The entire Hindu society is with him. All parties have an agenda of 'Eliminate the upper castes, persecute the Brahmins' - this is what we are discussing.

stories.title: Attack on YouTuber exposing flaws in his religion:Masked men stab him 14 times at home in Ghaziabad
stories.summary: In Ghaziabad, YouTuber Salim Vastik was attacked at his home by masked assailants who stabbed him 14 times and fled, leaving him bleeding. The attackers reportedly tried to slit his throat. Salim fell to the ground, screaming for help. Fearing capture, the assailants escaped. Neighbours rushed to the scene upon hearing the commotion and contacted Salim’s wife and son. The family immediately took him to a nearby hospital. Seeing his critical condition, he was referred to Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital (GTB) in Delhi. Salim sustained 14 stab wounds to his chest, abdomen, arms, neck, and legs. The police arrived after being informed and spoke to his family. Meanwhile, Hindu organisation members reached the hospital, demanding the arrest of the attackers and raising slogans against the administration. Pinki Chaudhary, president of the Hindu Raksha Dal, said Salim had left the Muslim faith and was a staunch Hindu. “Some people did not like his views, which led to this attack. This is a premeditated conspiracy. The police should encounter the attackers,” she said. The incident occurred on Friday in the Loni police station area. Now read the full matter in detail- Criminals came on bike without number According to locals, 50-year-old YouTuber Salim Vastik lives in Ashok Vihar Colony with his family. He owns two houses in the area—one as his office and the other as his residence with his wife and children. On Friday, he was at his office. At around 9 a.m., two helmeted attackers on an unregistered bike entered and began stabbing him repeatedly. Salim fell to the ground, bleeding heavily, and the assailants fled. Neighbours rushed to help and called his family, who took him to a nearby hospital. Salim has abandoned Islam and has displayed the national tricolour flag at his home. Son accuses AIMIM leader of orchestrating the attack Salim’s son stated that his father was alone in the office when two unknown youths stabbed him and fled. He accused Ashfaq, Sonu, Shahrukh, a Bhati builder, and a local AIMIM leader named Ajgar of orchestrating the attack. He had left Islam and used to speak openly Locals, on condition of anonymity, said Salim was formerly a Muslim and had served as a Maulvi. He later chose to leave the religion and currently follows none. He openly expressed his views on religious issues and has over 28,000 followers on YouTube. He has a son, Usman, and a daughter who is married. Hindu organizations staged protest outside the hospital Upon learning about the attack, Pinki Chaudhary and supporters staged a protest outside GTB Hospital. BJP leader Manoj Tiwari also arrived, spoke with Chaudhary, and received assurances from police for action, calming the situation. Chaudhary stated that Salim was always truthful, which is why he was targeted. ACP Loni says - Accused will be arrested soon ACP Siddharth Gautam said- A case has been registered based on the family member's complaint. So far two unknown attackers have been identified. CCTV footage is being examined. The accused will be arrested soon after identification.

stories.title: Varanasi woman ends life citing in-laws’ torture:Bank manager husband absconds, FIR lodged against 10 relatives
stories.summary: A young woman in Varanasi ended her life 15 months after her marriage. Her body was found hanging in her room, with a suicide note nearby. The note mentioned the torture she faced from her in-laws. She wrote, “My parents raised me with love and care, but I did not get that love in my in-laws’ house. I am my father’s princess.” The incident occurred on Friday in Mahadevpuram Colony under Shivpur police station. The deceased has been identified as Kajal Rai. Her husband works as an Assistant Manager at Bank of India, Maldahia branch. Based on the father’s complaint, police have filed a dowry-related murder case against 10 members of the in-laws’ family. Following the incident, the family of the husband has absconded. Police complaint 18 days before suicide Kajal had lodged a complaint against her in-laws for dowry harassment just a few days earlier. About 18 days before her suicide, she had registered a case at Shivpur police station on February 9. She told police that her marriage with Nitesh Kumar Singh had taken place on November 16, 2024. She alleged that her in-laws spent around ₹80 lakh on the wedding, and initially, everything was fine. However, soon after, demands for a car began, and she was regularly beaten and threatened over it. In her complaint, Kajal named her husband Nitesh Kumar Singh, brother-in-law Vivek Kumar Singh, Abhishek Kumar Singh, sister-in-law Priya Singh, Anchal Singh, and mother-in-law Kankalta Singh as responsible for harassment. She reiterated these allegations in her suicide note, writing that on February 7, she was verbally abused, beaten, and thrown out of the house. Mental harassment had pushed her to take her life. Father files FIR against 10 people The deceased’s father, Neeraj Rai, filed a complaint against 10 members of the in-laws’ family under dowry death and other serious charges. He said he had forced his daughter to go back to her in-laws’ house to save the marriage, but she was beaten over a luxury car and ultimately took her own life. Family alleges continued harassment and confinement After filing a police complaint, Kajal was allegedly confined on the third floor of her in-laws’ home. She was not allowed to talk to anyone. Her uncle, Ambuj Rai, said the family tried calling her repeatedly from noon, but she did not answer. They then went to her in-laws’ house. The door was locked from inside, prompting them to call police at 112. Police broke open the door and found Kajal hanging. Her in-laws had fled. The forensic team and police sent her body for post-mortem. FIR details Based on Neeraj Rai’s complaint, Shivpur police registered FIRs against the husband Nitesh Kumar Singh, brothers-in-law Vivek Singh, Abhishek Singh, sister-in-law Priya Singh, mother-in-law Kankalta Singh, sister-in-law Neetu Singh, Amit Singh, brother-in-law Anoop Singh, Narendra Pratap Singh, and Pramila Singh. The complaint stated that Kajal was harassed for dowry, isolated, and abused. Her sister-in-law allegedly attempted to electrocute her with a rod used to heat water, while both brothers had ill intentions. Kajal had informed her family multiple times about the harassment over phone.

stories.title: ₹12-crore Lamborghini released from police station on ₹8-crore bond:Security deposited in Kanpur court; car taken away in truck at midnight
stories.summary: A Lamborghini car worth about Rs 12 crore, which allegedly hit six people earlier this month, has been released from the police station after the court accepted a bail bond of Rs 8.30 crore. The order was issued on Friday by Chief Judicial Magistrate Suraj Mishra. The car was released from Gwaltoli police station at around 12:30 am and taken away on a truck. The car belonged to Shivam Mishra, son of businessman KK Mishra. Police had seized it after the accident on February 8 and kept it covered at the station. Court allowed release with strict conditions The court allowed the car’s release with the following conditions: Shivam’s lawyer Dharmendra Singh said documents of two vehicles worth Rs 7.5 crore and Rs 1 crore were submitted as security. After receiving the court order, police released the Lamborghini late at night. Owner arrested earlier, released same day Police arrested Shivam Mishra on February 12, four days after the accident. However, he was released within seven hours as the charges were bailable. On the same day, Shivam filed an application in court seeking release of the car. He also authorised his associate Sunil Kumar through a power of attorney to handle matters related to the vehicle. Accident took place on February 8 According to police, the Lamborghini hit six people on VIP Road in Kanpur on February 8. The impact was strong enough to damage a motorcycle, and the car’s front wheel climbed onto it. Police initially registered an FIR against an unknown driver several hours after the accident. Later, Shivam Mishra’s name was added to the FIR. Father claimed driver was behind the wheel On February 10, businessman KK Mishra told police that his son was not driving the car. He claimed their driver Mohan was behind the wheel at the time of the accident. The driver later appeared in court and claimed responsibility. However, the court did not accept his claim, noting that Shivam Mishra was named as the accused in the police report. Victim reported compromise, police denied agreement One of the injured persons, Mohammad Tausif, submitted a compromise document in court stating that his medical expenses had been paid and he did not want action. However, police said they had not received any official compromise agreement and continued the investigation. Police remand plea rejected Police had sought 14 days’ remand of Shivam Mishra after his arrest. The court rejected the request, stating that the charges were bailable and no strong grounds for remand were presented. He was released after submitting a personal bond of Rs 20,000. The investigation in the case is ongoing.

stories.title: Constable assaults youth at Vishwanath temple, pulls hair:Slapped, barred from darshan; female journalist faces harassment
stories.summary: In Kashi, at Baba Vishwanath Dham, police allegedly assaulted a young devotee (batuk). A constable slapped him three times in quick succession, after which a sub-inspector pulled his hair and pushed him behind the barricades. The youth managed to regain his balance, but he was subsequently barred from entering the temple, being sent back without completing his darshan. It is alleged that police also misbehaved with the youth’s companions. Reports indicate that female devotees standing in the line were pushed and jostled as well. On Friday, during Rangbhari Ekadashi, the deity, accompanied by Mata, was carried in a palanquin to the temple sanctum. Police reportedly stopped the young devotees outside, leading to an argument. Instead of calming the situation, officers allegedly resorted to assault. A female journalist was also reportedly harassed during the incident. See the pictures- Know the full matter According to tradition, on Thursday, the deity was taken in a palanquin about 500 metres away to the Mahant’s residence for Gauna rituals. On Friday, after completing the Gauna, the palanquin returned through key city areas, drawing over 200,000 devotees. Devotees, celebrating Holi, reached the temple sanctum where color celebrations took place. Police, however, stopped devotees at the Ganga gate outside. As devotees tried to enter, arguments broke out with police. During this, a constable reportedly grabbed the youth’s face and slapped him three times, after which a sub-inspector pulled his hair and forcibly removed him from the line. Despite waiting for hours, the youth was denied entry. Misbehavior with female journalist, scuffle with colleague During the Rangbhari Ekadashi coverage, a female journalist was reportedly pushed by police officers on duty at Gate No. 4. When another journalist tried to intervene, he was allegedly slapped and verbally abused by the same officers. DCP Gaurav Bansal said- All journalists who had I-cards were given permission for the Rangbhari Ekadashi program. Clear instructions were given to everyone that no one should misbehave with anyone. If any such case comes to notice with Batuk. If anyone is found at fault, action will be taken against them.

stories.title: How credible are the sexual harassment allegations against Shankaracharya?:Lawyer questions lone witness, highlights age contradiction
stories.summary: The Allahabad High Court has stayed the arrest of Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand in a case related to alleged sexual harassment of two minor disciples. The relief is temporary and will remain in effect until the third week of March, when the court will hear the matter again. The case was registered seven days ago at Jhunsi police station in Prayagraj following a court order under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act. Mahant Ashutosh Brahmachari, who filed the complaint, has claimed that medical examination reports confirm sexual abuse. However, Shankaracharya’s legal team has denied all allegations and termed the case a conspiracy. After the court’s order, Shankaracharya participated in Rangbhari Ekadashi celebrations in Varanasi. High Court hearing held in judge’s chamber The hearing took place on February 27 before Justice Jitendra Kumar Sinha. Due to a large crowd in the courtroom, the judge decided to hear the matter in his chamber. Senior advocates PN Mishra and Dilip Gupta appeared for Shankaracharya, while Additional Advocate General Manish Goyal represented the Uttar Pradesh government. The court made two key observations: The state government opposed the arrest stay, arguing that the case involves serious allegations under the POCSO Act and that granting relief could affect evidence collection. Arguments presented by the prosecution The state government opposed anticipatory bail and arrest protection, presenting the following arguments: The accused holds influence and could affect evidence and witnesses if arrest is stayed. Defence claims allegations are false and politically motivated Shankaracharya’s lawyers denied all allegations and raised several points in court: Legal expert explains importance of investigation and statements Supreme Court advocate Shashvat Anand said registration of an FIR does not prove guilt but only begins the legal process. Key points highlighted by the legal expert: Police investigation timeline so far Police have taken several steps since the FIR was registered: Background of the case The allegations relate to incidents during the Magh Mela and Mahakumbh events. Ashutosh Brahmachari filed a complaint in January, alleging sexual exploitation of minors. After police did not initially register a case, he approached the special POCSO court, which ordered an FIR. Shankaracharya has denied the allegations and earlier accused officials of conspiracy. After the High Court’s order, Shankaracharya told the media that the truth would come out during the investigation. The next hearing in the Allahabad High Court is scheduled for the third week of March. Until then, police cannot arrest Shankaracharya but can continue their investigation.

stories.title: Constable's collar grabbed, inspector tries to intervene:Chitrakoot man threatens, hurls abuses, refuses to cooperate
stories.summary: In Chitrakoot, a brazen man misbehaved with a constable in the middle of the road. He grabbed the officer by the collar and began hurling abuses. In front of four policemen, the accused continued shoving the on-duty constable while repeatedly warning, “Don’t try to make me a terrorist. You’ll call me to the station. You’ll make me sit there.” A video of the incident has surfaced, showing the constable along with his fellow officers. One officer is seen filming the incident while another tries to intervene. Despite this, the accused shows no sign of fear or hesitation. Following the constable’s complaint, a case was registered against the man, who has been arrested. Police stated that a week earlier, a case of assault had already been filed against the accused, with the same constable serving as the investigating officer. The man was reportedly attempting to intimidate him. The accused already has several cases registered against him. The incident occurred on Friday near Krishak Inter College at Bhauri Chowk in the Raipura police station area, around 20 kilometres from the district headquarters. First understand the entire incident in sequence... Constable Subhash Ram, posted at Raipura police station, had gone to investigate a case of assault near Krishak Inter College at Bhauri Chowk. At around 4:30 pm on Friday, the accused, Daddu Yadav from Bhauri village, arrived at the spot with his brother Chunbadda Yadav. Daddu began verbally abusing Subhash Ram openly. When the constable resisted, the accused grabbed his collar and started shoving him. During this, Raipura station officer Ashutosh Tiwari and other policemen arrived. Rather than arresting the man, they tried to mediate and calm him down. For several minutes, Daddu continued to misbehave and threaten the constable in front of four officers. The inspector attempted to reason with him while recording the incident and protecting the constable. Eventually, after much effort, the situation was brought under control. Now let's understand the case in detail... Accused arrested, strict action will be taken Regarding the case, Raipura Station In-charge Ashutosh Tiwari said- Based on the inspector's report, a case has been registered against the accused under several sections including obstructing government duty and assaulting an on-duty police officer. The accused has been arrested, while his brother is absconding. Strict action will be taken against the accused.

stories.title: Chargesheet against Dr. Rameez at KGMU:500 obscene videos found on laptop, Lucknow police files 800-page report
stories.summary: A charge sheet has been filed against Dr Rameezuddin Nayak at King George's Medical University, who allegedly pressured women for religious conversion. Lucknow police have prepared an 800-page charge sheet against him and three others, including statements from two victims, digital evidence, and forensic reports. Dr Rameez is accused of sexually assaulting a female doctor, forcing an abortion, and coercing her to convert. Forensic examination of three laptops seized from the accused revealed over 12 years’ worth of 4TB (4000 GB) data, including more than 500 obscene videos. These digital evidences have also been included in the charge sheet. Police stated that the accused allegedly engaged in such activities since his student days. The victim had attempted suicide The female doctor, posted in KGMU’s Pathology department, accused Dr Rameezuddin of sexual exploitation under the pretext of marriage and pressuring her for religious conversion. When she refused to convert, he allegedly reneged on the marriage proposal. Mentally harassed, the victim even attempted suicide. Based on her complaint, a case was registered at Chowk Kotwali under various sections, including rape, forced abortion, threats, and religious conversion. Blackmailed women by making videos Police investigations revealed that the accused approached women by posing as a sympathetic ally, gaining their trust through financial or career support, and then threatened to circulate obscene videos. Evidence confirms sexual assault, forced abortion, and religious conversion pressure against two young women. Parents and associates also named The charge sheet also names Dr Rameezuddin’s father Salimuddin, mother Khateja, and marriage witness Sharik Khan as accused. Inspector Chowk Nagesh Upadhyay stated that the charge sheet has been filed under seven sections, including rape, forced abortion, and religious conversion. Further court proceedings will continue from here.

stories.title: Rinku Singh’s father’s emotional last words:'Play your match bravely, every father deserves a son like you, I'll pray from hospital'
stories.summary: “Son, I love you very much. Play your match with full dedication. I will keep praying for you from the hospital.” Though cricketer Rinku Singh has lost his father, these words continue to echo in the hearts of family members and fans alike. His late father, Khanchand, said these emotional words from Yatharth Hospital in Noida, where he was undergoing treatment. late. Khanchand, who was battling fourth-stage liver cancer, passed away at 4:36 am on February 27 at the age of 60. He had been admitted to the hospital on February 23 after his health deteriorated. A father’s blessing before the big match Rinku Singh rushed from Chennai to Noida on February 24 after learning about his father’s condition. He had to skip a T20 World Cup practice session to be by his father’s side. He spent nearly six hours at the hospital before preparing to return to Chennai. Before leaving, Rinku informed his father that India had a crucial match against Zimbabwe on February 26 and that he needed to represent the country. Despite being in pain, Khanchand placed his hand on his son’s head and blessed him. Family members recall that he said, “One day, you will touch great heights. Never feel alone. Every father should have a son like you.” Though weak and suffering, he urged his son not to worry and promised to pray for him from the hospital. Pictures of the last rites held in Aligarh A life of struggle behind Rinku’s success Behind Rinku Singh’s success story lies the relentless struggle of his father. Khanchand worked as a gas cylinder delivery man (hawker) at a gas agency in Aligarh. To raise his five sons and one daughter, he spent years delivering LPG cylinders door-to-door. Initially, he delivered cylinders on a bicycle. Later, he shifted to transporting them by tempo. Watching his father toil day and night deeply affected young Rinku. As a child, he had promised his father, “One day, I will support you and free you from this hard labor.” After achieving success in cricket, Rinku fulfilled that promise. Rinku’s mother, Veena Devi, manages the household. He is the fourth among five brothers and one sister. His elder brothers are Sonu, Mukul, and Sheelu, while his younger siblings are sister Neha and brother Jeetu. The family once lived in Dangarh, Bulandshahr, before eventually moving to Aligarh. “My son is a star”: Father’s final interview On February 15, the day of the India–Pakistan T20 World Cup match, Khanchand spoke to Dainik Bhaskar. Despite feeling unwell, he watched the entire match. He said, “The match was good. I was not feeling well, but as soon as he hit a boundary, I felt fine. Rinku is a star. If he had faced more balls, he would have scored more runs.” In that match, Rinku scored 11 runs off four balls, including a four and a six. Khanchand proudly remarked that even small contributions in big matches make a difference. Family members recall that as he watched his son score those quick runs on television, he became emotional. He remembered Rinku’s early struggles and the hard work that brought him to the national stage. “He has worked very hard to reach here,” Khanchand had said. An unfulfilled wish Khanchand often expressed that he had seen his son become a star with his own eyes. His only remaining wish was to see Rinku settle down and start a family. He would say, “I have seen him become a star. I wish to see his family grow too. If I live long enough, I want to hold his children in my arms.” Sadly, that dream remained unfulfilled. After a prolonged battle with cancer, Khanchand succumbed to the disease. Wedding plans may be reconsidered Rinku Singh is engaged to Samajwadi Party MP Priya Saroj. The couple got engaged last year in a ceremony held in Lucknow. They are scheduled to get married in June 2026. However, sources suggest that following his father’s demise, the family may reconsider the wedding date. This is not the first time the wedding has been postponed. The initial date of November 18, 2025, was deferred due to a cricket series. A second date in February 2026 was canceled because of World Cup commitments. According to Rinku’s elder brother Sonu Singh, the IPL is scheduled between March 26 and May 31. The wedding is likely to take place once Rinku is free from his cricketing commitments. The ceremony is planned in Varanasi (Kashi), with a reception to be held in Aligarh. A son who played on, guided by his father’s blessings As Rinku Singh continues to represent India on the global stage, his father’s words remain a guiding force in his life. Even from a hospital bed, Khanchand chose encouragement over worry, pride over pain. His final message — to play wholeheartedly and not feel alone — reflects the enduring bond between a father and a son. For Rinku, every boundary, every run, and every milestone will now carry the silent blessing of a father who believed in him until his last breath.
