stories.title: Lucknow University hostel students protest over poor quality food:Authorities respond, ‘You’re making excuses to meet your boyfriend’
stories.summary: Students residing at the Ganga Hostel on the New Campus of Lucknow University have alleged severe hygiene lapses in the hostel mess and accused authorities of dismissing their complaints by questioning their character. The controversy surfaced after several students reportedly fell ill on February 25 after eating food served in the hostel mess. In protest, angry students locked the mess and staged a demonstration. To ascertain the truth of the matter, the Dainik Bhaskar team reached the spot. They spoke to the students. They said, "Stomach pain has become a common problem due to bad food and water. Kidney problems are occurring. When we complain, our character is questioned. We are told that we are making excuses to meet boyfriends. Provost Ma'am is also not listening to our complaints." Read the full report... “Basic hygiene is missing” Pranjali Yadav, a second-year LLB student residing at the hostel, alleged that hygiene standards in the mess are extremely poor. “There is a severe lack of basic hygiene. Sandwiches are made using stale potatoes. We have complained multiple times to the provost, but no action has been taken,” she said. She further claimed that the water in the hostel washrooms is visibly dirty. “No one would even want to touch that water, but we are forced to wash our hair with it,” she added. According to students, stomach pain has become so common that it is considered “normal” inside the hostel. Some even alleged that prolonged exposure to poor-quality food and water is leading to kidney-related issues. ₹60,000 annual hostel fee Ganga Hostel accommodates more than 200 female students from the Law Faculty, as well as BPharma, MPharma, BBA, and MBA courses. A few female assistant professors also reside there. Students pay ₹60,000 annually, which includes ₹24,000 towards mess charges. “No one listens to complaints” Students alleged that complaints about food quality are routinely deflected. “When we speak to the mess operators, they say ‘Ma’am will tell you.’ When we approach the provost, she says ‘Mohit will tell you.’ We are just made to run in circles,” Pranjali claimed. She also questioned why senior officials do not visit the hostel when all students are present. “When the Vice-Chancellor came on February 26, our classes were ongoing, so we couldn’t meet him. Why don’t senior officials visit on Sundays when everyone is available?” she asked. “Living on curd and rice for three days” Pranjali said she has been surviving on curd and rice for the past three days because the food is “not edible.” “We cannot even inform our parents, as they would worry. So we are dealing with the stress ourselves,” she said. “Character assassination instead of action” Another student, Shweta Pathak, alleged that whenever students raise concerns, their character is questioned. “When we complain, instead of resolving issues, they make comments about our character. That is why students are angry,” she said, adding that the Vice-Chancellor has assured action. Several students, requesting anonymity, claimed that they were told they were making excuses to meet their boyfriends when they raised issues or reported medical emergencies. Allegations of health risks, kidney concerns Students alleged that contaminated food and water have begun affecting health seriously. One student who consulted a doctor was reportedly warned about potential kidney damage due to poor dietary conditions. They claimed that the provost ignored repeated complaints and only intervened after students locked the mess. “Instead of addressing the issue, we were threatened and accused of making social media reels,” a student alleged. Medical facilities under scrutiny Students raised serious concerns about the lack of medical facilities inside the hostel. Asmita Singh, a second-year law student, said there is no ambulance service available at night. “In emergencies, students have to arrange their own transport, sometimes taking a sick student on a scooter,” she said. She further alleged that late-night health complaints are often dismissed as “drama.” According to students, the hostel lacks even a basic first-aid facility. “There are over 250 students, but only four or five strips of paracetamol are available. In emergencies, medicines have to be arranged from outside after much difficulty,” one student said. Student recalls falling ill after eating dal Meghna Shah, an LLB final-year student, recounted her experience of falling ill after consuming dal served in the mess. “I started vomiting soon after eating. When the provost arrived, she asked why I hadn’t gone to the dispensary myself,” Meghna said. “I was in no condition to walk. A doctor came only after my parents called.” She alleged that despite assurances of round-the-clock medical facilities, doctors are not available when needed. Protest and assurances Following the incident on February 25, students locked the mess and staged a protest demanding improved food quality and better medical facilities. They claim that hostel authorities attempted to threaten them, including warning that law faculty students might not be allotted hostel accommodation next session if they continued raising complaints. Students said they have now spoken to the Vice-Chancellor and are hopeful that conditions will improve. The university administration has yet to issue a detailed public response to the allegations.

stories.title: Politics heats up in UP as Kanshi Ram Jayanti approaches:Akhilesh calls birthday as Pichhde-Dalit-Alpsankhyak day; Mayawati also gets ready
stories.summary: In the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, Akhilesh Yadav’s ‘PDA’, the short name of Pichhde, Dalit and Alpsankhyak (backward, dalit and minority) formula in Uttar Pradesh proved highly effective. The SP-led grand alliance stalled the BJP’s juggernaut, winning 43 seats while the NDA managed only 36. The SP alone secured victory in 37 constituencies. Now, Akhilesh is aiming to replicate this strategy for the 2027 assembly elections, pitching a fight of 80% backward, Dalit, and minority voters against 20% upper-caste voters. Within the SP’s PDA strategy, Mayawati remains the biggest obstacle. She continues to consolidate the Dalit vote bank under the BSP. In response, Akhilesh has announced that Kanshi Ram’s Jayanti on March 15 will be celebrated as PDA Day, another attempt to woo Dalit voters. Mayawati, however, struck back sharply. She accused the SP of being anti-Dalit and described the move as a vote-grabbing tactic. Reopening old wounds from the Guest House scandal to renaming Dalit icons, she charged the SP with caste politics, betrayal, and anti-Bahujan policies. The critical question is: why is the Dalit vote bank so decisive for UP’s 2027 power equation? Will Akhilesh’s new strategy penetrate the BSP’s core voters, or can Mayawati retain her 21% Dalit vote share? Akhilesh announces celebration of PDA Day through social media On February 26, Akhilesh Yadav posted on social media that Kanshi Ram’s Jayanti on March 15 would be celebrated as PDA Day. He wrote, “PDA Day marks a new beginning, symbolically dedicated to all great individuals of the PDA society who have fought for the dignity, upliftment, and equality of every oppressed, distressed, and humiliated person, without ever siding with any dominant forces.” He added that all members of the PDA society were pleased that the mission of numerous PDA leaders like Kanshi Ram is being revived. Senior journalist Syed Qasim notes that in 2024, the narrative of ‘Constitution under threat’ shifted a large Dalit voter base to the SP-led grand alliance. The inactivity of BSP chief Mayawati also contributed to this shift. Akhilesh now aims to replicate the same success in the next Lok Sabha and assembly elections. Since the BSP’s large rally in Lucknow on October 9, 2025, the SP has been concerned that Dalit leanings are returning to the BSP. Akhilesh’s move to declare Kanshi Ram Jayanti as PDA Day is seen as an attempt to regain influence among Dalits. Mayawati’s response on social media indicates that the BSP is now alert about its core vote bank. She is determined not to repeat the mistakes of the 2024 Lok Sabha elections. Why Dalits are most important for political parties in UP Dalits make up more than 20-21% of UP’s population. Of the 403 assembly constituencies in the state, 84 are reserved for SCs. Key seats include Hathras, Khair (Aligarh), Nakur (Saharanpur), Nagina (Bijnor), Syana (Bulandshahr), Hapur, Bilari (Moradabad), Safipur (Unnao), Malihabad (Lucknow), and Machhlishahr (Jaunpur). Politically, these 84 seats are considered the key to power. To form a government, a party needs a majority of 202 seats. Strong performance in SC-reserved constituencies often determines a party’s success. In the 2022 assembly elections, Akhilesh, with allies like Suheldev Bharatiya Samaj Party (SBSP) and Rashtriya Lok Dal (RLD), won 20 of these seats, while the BJP-led NDA took 63. One seat was won by Raja Bhaiya’s Jansatta Democratic Party. Dalits remained united with Mayawati until 2012 Dalits in UP largely supported Congress until 1989. Kanshi Ram had been active in uniting this community since 1980. In 1984, he founded the Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP), India’s first political party for Dalits. In the 1989 state elections, the BSP contested 372 seats, winning 13 and securing 9.41% of votes. In the 1991 mid-term elections, the party’s performance remained similar, winning 12 seats with 9.44% votes. After the Babri Masjid demolition in 1992, the then CM Kalyan Singh of the BJP had resigned and President’s rule was imposed for a year. Despite expectations that BJP would benefit politically, the alliance of Kanshi Ram and Mulayam Singh altered the scenario. The BSP won 67 seats with 11.12% votes, while SP secured 109 seats. Mulayam Singh became CM first under the agreement. Mayawati became Chief Minister after Guest House incident On June 2, 1995, the Guest House scandal occurred. Mayawati withdrew support, toppling the SP government, and became CM with BJP backing. This government did not complete its term, and she later recommended President’s rule. In 1996, elections again gave BSP 19.64% of votes, with Dalits openly supporting Mayawati. No party won a majority, leading to President’s rule. BSP formed alliances later, with Mayawati serving as CM briefly before political maneuvers brought BJP-led governments. By 2002, BSP contested alone, winning 98 seats with its vote share rising to 23.06%. Mayawati became CM for the third time with BJP support. After political shifts, Mulayam Singh returned to power. In 2007, campaigning against SP’s misgovernance, BSP won 206 seats with 30.43% votes, securing a majority. The party maintained dominance until 2012, after which its decline began. Why did the Dalit vote bank slip away from BSP Senior journalist Ratan Mani Lal explains that after 1989, Dalits increasingly looked to BSP. Mayawati received up to 80% Dalit votes in 2007. However, post-2007, non-Jatav Dalits felt neglected and some shifted to SP. Due to Dalit oppression under SP, the 2014 Lok Sabha and 2017 assembly elections saw Dalits favor BJP. Only the Jatav vote base remained loyal to BSP, accounting for roughly 12% of the state’s Dalit voters. BJP focused on non-Jatav Dalits like Balmiki, Dhobi, Pasi, and Kori communities. In 2024, by highlighting threats to the Constitution and reservations, the opposition, led by SP, captured a significant portion of Dalit votes. This helped SP’s candidate Awadhesh Pasi win in Ayodhya, a general seat, leveraging the Pasi community. SP will organize symposium and other programs on Kanshiram Jayanti SP spokesperson Rajendra Chaudhary says the March 15 programs will include seminars and other events across the state. Kanshi Ram fought to secure rights for the poor and marginalized; SP aims to continue this mission, ensuring justice for the PDA community. Akhilesh Yadav continues to emphasize the PDA agenda. On Mayawati’s counter, SP spokesperson Udayveer Singh notes that recognizing a great leader should not cause discontent. The 2019 SP-BSP alliance had settled previous disputes. Akhilesh’s efforts mirror Kanshi Ram’s lifelong struggle for Dalit and backward communities, which is why many Dalits are now aligning with SP. Know about Kanshi Ram-

stories.title: Judge’s father shot dead while going to mosque in Moradabad:History sheeter brother-in-law kills victim over property dispute
stories.summary: The father of a woman judge was shot dead on Friday evening in Moradabad while he was on his way to a mosque to offer Taraweeh prayers after breaking his fast during Ramadan. The accused is his own brother-in-law, who allegedly shot him in the head from behind at point-blank range. The victim, Mohammad Asad, collapsed on the road immediately after being shot. Family members and locals rushed him to the district hospital, where doctors declared him dead. Shot while going to mosque for Taraweeh prayers Mohammad Asad, a resident of Jigar Colony, owned ‘Alvina Bakery’, which has several branches across Moradabad. On Friday at around 7:30 pm, he was going to Lal Masjid on a scooter with his elder brother-in-law Mazahir to offer Taraweeh prayers. According to police and eyewitness accounts, as their scooter reached Bangla village intersection under the Nagfani police station area, a man arrived on a motorcycle from behind and opened fire. One of the bullets hit Asad in the head. He fell on the spot, seriously injured. Police reached the scene soon after receiving information and shifted him to the district hospital. However, doctors declared him dead on arrival. Eyewitness says accused shot him from behind Mazahir, who was riding with Asad and witnessed the incident, told police that the accused was another brother-in-law, identified as Zafar. He said Asad was driving the scooter while he was sitting behind. As they reached the intersection, Zafar came from behind on a motorcycle and shot Asad in the head at close range. After the shooting, Mazahir immediately took Asad to hospital, but he could not be saved. Police are questioning Mazahir as the main eyewitness in the case. Property dispute and extortion demand suspected motive Family members told police that Asad had an ongoing property dispute with Zafar over a house. They also alleged that Zafar had been demanding ₹10 lakh from Asad and had previously threatened him. An FIR had already been registered against Zafar at Nagfani police station in connection with the dispute. Police said Zafar is a history-sheeter and has several serious criminal cases registered against him. His son Saiful and son-in-law Faizan are also suspected to have been involved in the incident. Zafar is a resident of Dahariya Mohalla in the Nagfani area. Victim’s daughter and son-in-law are judges Mohammad Asad’s daughter, Asma Sultana, and her husband, Zulkar Nain Alam, are both judges. Asma Sultana is reportedly posted in Bulandshahr district. News of the killing spread quickly, and hundreds of people gathered at the hospital. Many expressed anger over the murder, especially as it took place during Ramadan while the victim was going for prayers. Police form five teams to arrest accused Senior Superintendent of Police (SSP) Satpal Antil said five police teams have been formed to arrest the accused. Police are conducting raids at possible hideouts. SP City Kumar Ranvijay Singh said initial investigation suggests the murder was linked to a property dispute. He said the accused will be arrested soon. Police have also questioned several people at the scene and are continuing their investigation.

stories.title: Daughters slit father’s throat and kills him in Muzaffarnagar:Harassed over marriage pressure, daughter ends constant taunts
stories.summary: A man was brutally killed by his two daughters while he slept at home in Muzaffarnagar. The elder daughter, with the help of her 16-year-old sister, allegedly slit her father's throat with a sickle and inflicted multiple wounds on his stomach and shoulders during the night. The crime came to light on Monday morning when their mother discovered the body and raised an alarm. Neighbours gathered as police were informed. The daughters initially pretended to grieve, but officers grew suspicious during questioning. Under strict interrogation, the elder daughter confessed to the murder. The incident occurred in Morna village under the Bhopa police station limits. The body of Ramprasad (55), a resident of Morna, was found in a bloody condition on a cot near the main gate of the house on Monday morning. Multiple attacks were made on his neck and body with a sharp weapon. When his wife Chandrakali saw her husband's body around 7 am in the morning, she raised an alarm. After this, villagers gathered in crowds. Wife Chandrakali, two sons Amit and Sumit, daughter Komal, and a 16-year-old minor daughter started crying and wailing. Upon receiving the information, SP Rural Aditya Bansal, CO Devvrat Bajpai, and Station In-charge Inspector Jasvir Singh reached the spot. The forensic team also inspected the crime scene. The body was sent for a post-mortem. Police questioned the deceased's wife, both sons, and daughters. Family members accused unknown persons of the murder. Daughters kept changing their statements repeatedly SP Rural Aditya Bansal said - During the investigation, several clues were found at the scene. The dog squad also kept circling in the house. This deepened the suspicion of the family members. Family members were interrogated one by one. During this, unmarried daughter Komal (32) and younger daughter (16) kept changing their statements repeatedly. However, upon strict questioning, they confessed to the crime. Elder daughter Komal said - Father discriminated between son and daughter. He used to taunt daily. He would say that I am 32 years old. Neither am I getting married nor do I have a job. The younger daughter is also getting spoiled because of you. Looking at you people, we are losing respect in the village society. We were troubled by father's daily taunts. Went to sleep after committing murder at 2 AM My younger sister and I planned to kill our father. Around 2 AM, father was sleeping in the gallery near the outer gate. We both struck his neck multiple times with a sickle. My younger sister held father's legs so he couldn't break free. To ensure he wouldn't survive, we also struck his shoulders and stomach multiple times with the sickle. After killing our father, we both went to our room and slept. In the morning, when mother raised an alarm, we both pretended to cry with her to avoid suspicion. Ramprasad owned 25 bigha farmland Among Ramprasad's 6 children, the two elder daughters, Lata and Shilpi, are married. Meanwhile, both sons used to help him with the ancestral 25 bigha farming. After the father's murder, the sons and wife are in terrible condition. SP Rural Aditya Bansal said- Both accused daughters have been taken into custody. One daughter is a minor. Both had planned to kill their father just two days ago. They carried out the crime when they got the opportunity on Sunday night.

stories.title: Lab owner father killed stuffed in drum in Lucknow:Police detains son after 3 days of disappearance
stories.summary: The body of a middle-aged man was found inside a drum in Lucknow’s Ashiyana area. The deceased has been identified as Manvendra Singh, a pathology lab owner. The incident came to light this evening at House No. 91, located in Sector L under the Ashiyana police station limits. Police have taken the body into custody and begun an investigation. Preliminary findings suggest that Manvendra Singh was allegedly murdered by his son. The police have detained the accused son and started questioning him. Officers are also interrogating local residents as part of the investigation. However, the motive behind the crime has not yet been established. See photos Son being questioned in murder connection According to police, Manvendra Singh had been missing since 20 February, and a missing person’s report had been registered. Police were actively searching for him. During the investigation, his mobile phone’s last location was traced to his pathology lab in Kakori. Officers searched the premises but could not recover the phone. Reliable police sources said his son, Akshat, was questioned during the probe. He initially claimed that his father had died by suicide. However, he later changed his statement and allegedly confessed to killing him. Following this, police intensified their interrogation. Body cut into 2 parts, torso recovered from drum at house During questioning, Akshat allegedly told police that he murdered his father at their home. He then cut the body into two parts to dispose of it more easily. He reportedly placed the remains in a car and dumped the head elsewhere, while hiding the torso inside a drum at the house. He did not get an opportunity to dispose of the torso. On Monday evening, police took Akshat to the house in Ashiyana, where the torso of Manvendra Singh was recovered from a drum. Police are continuing to question him to locate the missing head. Akshat is a BCom student. At the time of the incident, Manvendra’s wife was in the village, while his daughter was present at home.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:HAL dismisses Tejas crash reports; Yogi signs ₹6,000 cr agreements in Singapore more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news updates from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top headlines: 1. HAL dismisses Tejas crash reports Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) on Monday denied reports of a crash involving the Indian Air Force (IAF) fighter jet Tejas. HAL stated that no such incident had occurred. On the ground, there was only a minor technical glitch, and no accident took place in the air. 2. Yogi signs ₹6,000 cr agreements in Singapore Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath addressed members of the Indian diaspora in Singapore, stating that Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s guiding principle of ‘Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas’ (collective effort, inclusive growth) underlines that development is meaningful only when it is shared. ‘Every individual has a contribution to make,’ he said. 3. FIR against Avimukteshwaranand in Prayagraj Police start an investigation against Swami Avimukteshwaranand under the POCSO Act. Teams inspect Magh Mela camp, map routes, and record statements of minor victims. 4. Seven terrorists, including Jaish commander killed in Kishtwar Indian Army’s White Knight Corps eliminates terror network after a 326-day operation. Top Jaish commander Saifullah among seven militants killed in Jammu and Kashmir. 5. Galgotias University faces backlash over ‘robotic dog’ claim Galgotias University apologises after claiming a robotic dog as its invention at AI Summit. Stall shut down and lights were cut off following embarrassment and controversy. 6. Saint community divided over POCSO case against Shankaracharya The POCSO court in Prayagraj has ordered the registration of an FIR against Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati over allegations of sexual exploitation involving two minor children. 7. Anti-govt protests erupt in major Iranian universities Anti-government protesters raised the pre-revolution lion and sun flag at Sharif University in Tehran, where hundreds marched through the campus. At the same time, pro-government demonstrators set fire to US and Israel flags. 8. Sanjay Dutt’s Lucknow roadshow draws massive crowd Sanjay Dutt greets fans and promotes environmental awareness during visit. BJP MLA showers flowers as a large crowd gathers for a Mumbai-style roadshow. 9. Student dies as exam-bound van collides with truck Class 10 student killed after Magic van crashed into a truck in Lakhimpur Kheri. 16 people were on board; several were injured while travelling to board examinations. 10. Rashmika Mandanna, Vijay Deverakonda confirm wedding Rashmika Mandanna and Vijay Deverakonda announce marriage, confirming long-running rumours. Fans celebrate as the popular on-screen pair prepares to tie the knot.

He said, The current situation in the country, and especially the growing opposition to UGC regulations, has inspired him to enter politics. The party's name is inspired by Lord Ram. See 2 pictures Atmosphere of discontent regarding UGC Now know about Alankar Agnihotri Alankar Agnihotri is a resident of Kanpur. His father passed away in his childhood. His mother worked in a bank. In 1998, Alankar secured the 21st position in the UP Board 12th examination. After this, he completed B.Tech from Banaras Hindu University and started working. In 2014, when all of Alankar's younger brothers were settled and his sister was married, he left his job to prepare for UPPCS and qualified the exam in 2019.

stories.title: Police beat Air Force jawan, call soldiers thieves:Soldier claims Kanpur police slapped him 70 times; eardrum ruptured
stories.summary: I was returning from a wedding at 11 PM when a white Bolero stopped near me. There were policemen inside. First, they asked my name. Then they asked what my father does. I told them he is no more. To this, they said your father must have had a name. I said I am in the armed forces. Please talk properly. They replied - Army men are thieves. Saying this, they grabbed my collar. When I tried to free myself, my collar was torn apart. When I started making a video, they snatched my phone. They called 2-4 more people, forced me into the vehicle, and brought me to the police station. They beat me a lot at night. They slapped me at least 70-80 times. Hit me on my back. My eardrum got ruptured. They took my phone but are claiming they didn't. This is the statement of Air Force soldier Nitish Sachna. He has been undergoing treatment at Kanpur's Air Force hospital for 3 days. He alleges that the police assaulted him. His mother has complained about the incident to DCP South. The investigation has been handed over to ADCP. The incident took place on February 19. Nitish Sachan (26), a resident of Devmanpur village in Ghatampur police station area, is posted in the Air Force. He is a PORAL, i.e., Aircraft Maintenance Officer. He is posted at Jamnagar Air Force Station in Gujarat. These days he has come to his home. He said that on the night of February 19, he had gone to attend the wedding of his friend Arpit Sahu's brother, who is a resident of Nauranga village. While returning from there at night, around 11 o'clock, he was walking home from the guesthouse located on Musanagar Road. Meanwhile, the patrol team of the Ghatampur police stopped him. They were in a white Bolero. Forcefully taken in vehicle after protest Nitish Sachan said that the police first asked his name. They misbehaved after getting information about his father. When he identified himself as a soldier, they abused him. They said - soldiers are thieves. When he protested, they forcefully put him in the vehicle and took him to the police station. They beat him there. Beat him so badly that his left eardrum ruptured. One eye turned completely black. Along with this, there are marks all over his body. After this, the police took action for breach of peace and took him to Ghatampur CHC. From there, he was referred to Kanpur. Family members allege that police did not take him for further treatment. He was released after taking action for breach of peace. After this, family members took him to the Seven Air Force Hospital in Kanpur. There, examination confirmed rupture of the eardrum. Nitish Sachan has been undergoing treatment at Air Force Hospital for 3 days. Now, Nitish's mother, Rekha Sachan, wife of late Dhirendra Sachan, met DCP South Dipendra Nath Chaudhary and told him about the entire incident. She filed a complaint and demanded action. Kanpur DCP South Dipendra Nath Chaudhary- The soldier's mother has given a complaint letter. The investigation of the incident has been handed over to ADCP Yogesh Kumar. Action will be taken against guilty police personnel based on the investigation report.

stories.title: Prayagraj student commits suicide just before maths paper:School topper fears exam, makes panic call to friend
stories.summary: An intermediate student died by suicide in Prayagraj just before his exam, after telling a friend he was terrified of mathematics and unable to face the paper. The school topper in Class 10 was considered highly talented by both his family and teachers. The incident occurred on Monday morning in the Mudera area under Dhumanganj police station. In Mundera, Jai Singh lives with his wife and their two sons, Sameer (17) and Prince (10). Sameer was a Class 12 student, while Prince studied in Class 5. Sameer’s examinations were underway, and he studied at Munni Devi Inter College. He was scheduled to sit his mathematics paper on Monday. His cousin Satyam said that Sameer Yadav had his maths exam at 2:30 pm on Monday and had been under stress for several days while preparing. He had also stayed up late studying on Sunday night. Mother screamed after seeing son hanging On Monday morning, around 7 AM, Sameer's mother went to wake him up. After calling several times from outside the room, there was no response from inside. On suspicion, family members tried to open the door. When the door was opened, everyone was shocked to see the scene inside. Sameer was hanging from a noose inside the room. Family members immediately brought him down and tried to take him to the hospital. But then, he had already died. Upon receiving the information, Dhumaganj police reached the spot. Friend tried to console him, but he cut the phone According to cousin brother Satyam, just before suicide, Sameer called one of his friends. He said that he was not able to understand Math. He was very scared about the exam. The friend also tried to console Sameer. But after a while, he cut the phone. When Sameer's phone call history was checked after the incident, his friend's number was found dialed last. When the friend was contacted, he gave this information to the family members. Sameer's father, Jai Singh, runs a small grocery shop in Mundera Mandi to support the family. He was the elder of two brothers. Younger brother Prince studies in the fifth grade. Since their son's death, the parents have been in terrible condition, crying continuously. School topper in 10th grade Family members said that Sameer was very serious and disciplined in his studies. He was the topper of his school in 10th grade. He had a strong grasp on all other subjects, but he often felt pressure regarding mathematics. He was an intermediate student at Munni Devi Inter College in Mundera and wanted to prepare for competitive exams in the future Dhumangunj station in-charge Rajesh Upadhyay said - The student has committed suicide. The body has been sent for post-mortem. No complaint has been received from the family. Police is investigating the matter. Along with the student's mobile call details, an investigation is being done on other angles.

stories.title: Jhansi doctor dies by suicide at home:Hangs from the fan after wife children leave for school
stories.summary: The dentist husband of Professor Radhika Chaudhary of Bundelkhand University in Jhansi committed suicide. On Monday morning, Dr. Neeraj Kuril had breakfast with his family. Both children went to school. Around 9 AM, his wife Radhika left for duty. Afterwards, he made a noose from a rope and hanged himself from the fan. When the maid arrived, the door wouldn’t open, and after knocking for a long time, neighbors alerted Professor Radhika. Even after her arrival, the door remained locked, forcing them to break the gate’s mesh. When his wife went inside after opening the latch, her husband was hanging from the noose. Seeing this, his wife fainted and fell. Currently, the police have taken the body into custody and started investigating the matter. The incident took place in the residential complex of Bundelkhand University in the Nawabad police station area. See three pictures of the incident site

stories.title: Scorpio's number plate removed and replaced with 'YADAV' in Lucknow:Red-blue light and siren installed; vehicle seized by police after chase
stories.summary: Young men removed the real number plate of their car to show off in reels and display status in Lucknow. They wrote 'Yadav' instead of the number and drove around in a Scorpio. The accused were caught during a police check at night. The Gomti Nagar Extension police have seized the vehicle and are investigating the people who were in it. Car caught at 1:30 AM on the G-20 road Gomti Nagar Extension Inspector Sudhir Awasthi was patrolling with his team. During this time, they spotted a speeding Scorpio with red-blue lights and a siren. Police stopped the vehicle on suspicion. Investigation revealed that the car's number plate had been removed and kept inside. Instead, 'Yadav' was written on the outside where the number should have been. 8 young men were riding, making reels with a hooter According to police, 8 young men were riding the vehicle. The vehicle is registered in the name of Arun Kumar Yadav, while Sachin Kumar Yadav was driving it. The youths were making reels with hooters and loud songs at high speed, posing a risk of accidents on the road. Police have seized the Scorpio while taking action under the Motor Vehicle Act.

stories.title: Female doctor from Nagaland molested at Gorakhpur AIIMS:Accused hurls vulgar remarks; intimidates her by taking off shirt
stories.summary: A disturbing case of molestation emerges at Gorakhpur AIIMS as a female doctor from Nagaland is harassed on February 22. While returning from Orion Mall around 8 PM, three men chased her for about 1.5 km, making lewd comments. One man intimidated her, removed his shirt, and, near Gate No. 2 of AIIMS, inappropriately touched her before fleeing when she screamed. After reaching the campus, the doctor complained about it to the North East Federation of All India Resident Doctors (NAFORD). Following this, NAFORD AIIMS posted on its X handle, tagging the Chief Minister's Office. Read what NAFORDEMES posted on X NAFORDEMES posted on X: A third-year Obstetrics and Gynecology resident at AIIMS Gorakhpur experienced severe racial harassment and sexual assault. On the night of February 22, around 8 PM, while exiting Orion Mall in Gorakhpur, three men stared at her and made lewd comments. They also made racial comments towards the doctor, who hails from the northeastern region of the country. The three men continued to follow her on the road leading to AIIMS Gate Number Two. During this, they all kept hurling abuses. One of them deliberately took off his shirt to intimidate the female doctor. Near the army camp at Gate Number Two, a man inappropriately touched a female doctor. This caused deep shock and trauma to the female resident doctor. AIIMS Police Station In-charge Chandra Prakash Pandey said, The victim doctor has submitted a complaint to the AIIMS police. Following this, the police have initiated legal action. All CCTV footage from Orion Mall to AIIMS is being scanned to identify the accused.

stories.title: Tensions rise at Lucknow University over ‘Lal Baradari’ makeover work:Students clash over existence of mosque or temple at the site
stories.summary: The controversy over Lal Baradari in Lucknow University campus has escalated. While one day earlier, a group of students offered namaz and had iftar, the next day, that is today (Feb 23), another group also came forward. The second group approached close to the already protesting students. During this time, slogans of Jai Bhavani, Jai Shri Ram were raised. The atmosphere inside the campus is becoming tense. Before this situation, Congress Rajya Sabha MP Imran Pratapgarhi made a post on Facebook. He wrote - The university administration should not make the campus a laboratory of hatred. That place should be opened for children. It should be noted that a 'Lal Baradari' structure is present inside the campus, where it is claimed that there is a mosque. However, many students also say that there is a small temple inside it. As the building became quite dilapidated, the university administration is getting it renovated. As soon as construction work started there, a group of students began protesting. On Sunday, digging began for installing fencing in the Lal Baradari premises. Meanwhile, the police force was also deployed at the spot. Upon learning about the construction work, a large number of NSUI students reached the spot. Students started creating a ruckus while protesting against the construction work. They said that Lal Baradari is an ASI-protected site, so no construction can be done without its permission. Some students also alleged that the university administration wants to stop the entry of people of a particular religion at this site. For this purpose, the entire premises is being sealed.

stories.title: 22-year-old Army Captain dies of heart attack:Only son posted in Kashmir; mortal remains arrive today
stories.summary: A 22-year-old Captain, Aman Singh, from Kushinagar, died of a heart attack in Jammu and Kashmir. When his condition worsened, fellow soldiers carried him on their shoulders to a helipad. He was then airlifted to Srinagar by helicopter, but doctors could not save him. The Captain had been posted in Baramulla for a year. He was a resident of Hata and was the only son of his family. The mortal remains of the late officer will be brought from Srinagar to Delhi and then to Gorakhpur airport. From there, they will be taken to his ancestral village with full state honours. According to airport sources, his body is expected to reach Gorakhpur by around 2 pm on Monday. Health deteriorated suddenly during duty... Captain Aman was on duty Sunday morning in Baramulla. Between about 9 am and 11 am, his health suddenly worsened. Because the terrain was remote and mountainous, fellow soldiers carried him on their shoulders to the helipad. From there he was flown to the Army hospital in Srinagar, where he died at 2 pm. His teacher-uncle Virendra Singh said the Army informed the family that Aman died due to cardiac arrest. Neighbour Pawan Singh said that as soon as news of his death reached the village, the entire area was stunned. The family was inconsolable, and large numbers of people arrived to offer condolences. Aman was the only son Captain Aman was the only child of his parents. His father, Yashwant Singh, is a mechanical engineer in the private sector and currently lives in Varanasi. Aman was unmarried. His grandmother, uncle, aunt, and cousins live in the village. Aman completed his studies up to Intermediate at Hallmark World School in Gorakhpur. He took admission in BTech (Civil Engineering) in Ghaziabad. After the first semester, he was selected for the post of Lieutenant in the Indian Army through the Technical Entry Scheme (TES). Excellent in studies, selected in army through TES Aman studied up to Intermediate at Hallmark World School in Gorakhpur. He then enrolled for BTech (Civil Engineering) in Ghaziabad. After the first semester, he was selected into the Indian Army through the Technical Entry Scheme and appointed Lieutenant. He had joined the Army two years ago and was recently promoted to Captain. Villagers say he was bright in studies from childhood and always wanted to serve the nation in a high position. Pride of Hata and the entire district His untimely death has cast a pall of grief across Hata and the entire Kushinagar district. People are reaching his residence to pay tribute.

stories.title: Students on way to exam meet with accident, one dead:Magic collides with truck in Lakhimpur; 16 onboard, several injured
stories.summary: A Magic van carrying students on their way to sit their Class 10 board exam collided with a truck in Lakhimpur Kheri. One Class 10 student died on the spot, while several others were seriously injured. A total of 16 students, including the driver, were travelling in the vehicle. The impact was so severe that the students got trapped inside the van. A student named Chanchal, who was seated in the front, died. Two other students sitting in front suffered broken legs and head injuries, along with serious injuries to their arms. The front portion of the Magic was completely damaged. The roof was ripped off, the steering wheel broke, and the front windscreen shattered, with glass shards piercing students’ faces. The accident occurred at around 7:10 am on Monday on the Dhakherwa–Dhaurahra highway under Padhua police station limits. According to police, 15 students from Uma Devi Public School were travelling in the Magic to appear for their board exam at Maa Gayatri Vidya Mandir. The van and truck collided head-on near GS Singh Crusher. Hearing screams after the crash, people working in nearby fields rushed to the spot and informed police. They tried to rescue the children trapped inside, but the crushed vehicle made it difficult. Police arrived shortly after and broke open the van’s doors to pull the children out. The injured students were sent to hospital, while Chanchal’s body was sent for post-mortem. As soon as news of the accident reached the victim’s family, chaos and grief spread among relatives. A large crowd gathered at the hospital premises. This news is being continuously updated...

stories.title: 'India has shown its strength to the world', says Yogi:₹6,000 crore agreements signed in Singapore; 20,000 youths to get jobs
stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath addressed members of the Indian diaspora in Singapore, stating that Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s guiding principle of ‘Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas’ (collective effort, inclusive growth) underlines that development is meaningful only when it is shared. ‘Every individual has a contribution to make,’ he said. He added that there is a sense of pride in how ‘New India’ is demonstrating its strength globally and is establishing itself as the world’s third-largest economy. India’s rise in digital and start-up sectors He remarked that 11 years ago, few would have imagined India leading conversations on Digital India and start-ups. ‘Today, this is a reality. India has not only spoken about it but has delivered,’ he said. Referring to the AI Summit held in Delhi, he noted that heads of state from 20 countries attended and representatives from more than 100 nations participated. Leaders from developed countries, he said, praised the decisive steps taken under Prime Minister Modi’s leadership for the benefit of 1.4 billion people, and commended the vision of a “New India”. Investment push during Singapore visit CM Yogi is on a four-day visit to Singapore and Japan. On Monday, he met business leaders in Singapore and invited them to invest in Uttar Pradesh. Three Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) worth ₹6,650 crore were signed with Universal Success Group. The proposed investments will focus on group housing, logistics and hyperscale data centres. These projects are expected to generate employment for more than 20,000 people. He told investors that the state government is ensuring faster and simpler approvals. With a population of over 250 million, Uttar Pradesh represents a vast market, he said. He also highlighted improvements in law and order, expansion of expressways and stronger connectivity, stating that these developments offer long-term advantages for investors. Delegation and upcoming schedule The Chief Minister was accompanied by Finance Minister Suresh Khanna and Industries Minister Nand Gopal Nandi. While the two ministers were dressed in business suits, CM Yogi was seen in his traditional saffron attire. During the three-day Singapore leg of the tour, he is scheduled to meet the CEOs of 25 companies. He will then travel to Japan on 25 February as part of the state’s continued global investment outreach. 3 pictures of Singapore tour- For every update regarding CM Yogi’s Singapore visit, stay tuned with Bhaskar English live blog-

stories.title: FIR against Avimukteshwaranand in Prayagraj:Police reach Varanasi, may question him and consider arrest after court order
stories.summary: After an FIR was registered against Swami Avimukteshwaranand on allegations of sexual abuse of children, the Prayagraj Police have intensified their investigation. On Monday afternoon, a police team reached Varanasi. The team may question the Shankaracharya and, if required, could proceed with his arrest. Meanwhile, on Monday morning, the Shankaracharya held a meeting with lawyers at his Varanasi ashram. It is believed he may approach the High Court to seek protection from arrest. After the meeting, he addressed a press conference, stating: ‘I am not running anywhere. I will face the police. The students who have alleged sexual abuse are not from my gurukul. The public does not trust the UP Police. The investigation should be handed over to the police of a state where the BJP is not in power.’ Police inspection at Magh Mela site On Sunday, police visited the Magh Mela area along with complainant Ashutosh Brahmachari. They inspected the location where the Shankaracharya’s camp had been set up. Officers prepared a map of the entry and exit routes to the camp and surveyed the surrounding area. The complaint was originally submitted on 24 January by Ashutosh Maharaj to the Police Commissioner. He levelled allegations of sexual abuse of children during Magh Mela 2026 and Mahakumbh 2025. Subsequently, on 8 February, he approached the Special POCSO Court in Prayagraj, alleging inaction by the police. Court proceedings and FIR On 13 February, two children were produced before the court. On 21 February, their statements were recorded on camera. Acting on the court’s order, an FIR was lodged the same day at Jhunsi police station. In the case, Avimukteshwaranand, his disciple Mukundanand and two to three unidentified individuals have been named as accused. Political reactions Ajay Rai, the Uttar Pradesh Congress president, said that levelling allegations against the Shankaracharya would prove very costly for the BJP. He described it as the 'last nail in the coffin' for the party, asserting that the religious leader has always spoken the truth. Emotional scenes at the ashram The allegations also triggered emotional scenes. A woman broke down in tears before Avimukteshwaranand. Responding to her, he said: 'One cries when one’s guru turns out to be wrong. There is no need to weep over someone’s conspiracy.' The woman gestured in denial and said, 'Bhagwati is with you.' The Shankaracharya replied: ‘Governments want such Shankaracharyas who engage in sycophancy, who say what the government wants and speak as instructed. But we cannot become those who merely comply.’ The woman had arrived that morning to seek his blessings.

stories.title: Instagram friendship turns fraud with job lure:Fraudsters used dead Hardoi youth’s ID to extort cash, jewellery from Lucknow girl
stories.summary: A fraudster befriended a young woman from Lucknow’s Madiyanv area on social media and duped her of cash and jewellery. The accused lured her with the promise of a job. To execute the scam, they used the ID of a deceased person. When the matter came to light, they began pressuring her to settle. On refusal, they threatened to circulate obscene photos. She had started chatting on Instagram with a youth who promised her employment and then deceived her into giving him money and gold ornaments. The victim’s father, a resident of Aadharkheda Faizullaganj, said his daughter became friends with a youth on Instagram who spoke through the ID lakshay_0606. During conversations, he offered to arrange a job. He then manipulated her into transferring money multiple times into different bank accounts. He also intimidated her into sending gold ornaments through buses travelling from Kaiserbagh to Hardoi — three chains, two rings, six earrings, one top and two gold lockets. The truth came out after asking many people After learning about the incident, the father traced the accounts where the money had been sent and contacted Kundli Devi from Unnao, whose account had also received funds. She said she knew the youth and would arrange a meeting. He also contacted Radha Pasi of Juda village on Shahabad Road in Hardoi. She revealed the Instagram ID was actually being operated by Sandeep Pandey alias Sanjeev Pandey, son of Muneem Pandey, and Sonu Sardar, son of Ajit Singh. The youth named ‘Lakshay’, whose ID was used, had already died. Threatened for Reconciliation The victim’s father said that on 10 February 2026, when he went to Hardoi to gather information, the accused messaged his daughter on Instagram offering a settlement and promising to return the money and jewellery. When she refused, Sanjeev Pandey and Sonu Sardar allegedly threatened to upload obscene photos of her on social media. Out of fear, she gradually handed over gold jewellery kept at home to them. Inspector Shivanand Mishra of Madiyanv police station said a case has been registered and investigation is underway with the help of evidence.

stories.title: Chinese manja injures biker in Lucknow:Woman, passerby help stop bleeding, youth out of danger
stories.summary: Despite Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath’s orders and strict police measures to curb the use of banned Chinese manja, another serious accident was reported in Lucknow on Sunday evening. A biker suffered a deep neck injury after the sharp kite string got entangled around his throat while he was riding near the IT intersection. The injured youth, identified as Sujit, managed to stop his bike immediately, preventing the string from cutting deeper. However, the sharp manja caused a severe wound and heavy bleeding, creating panic among people present at the spot. Woman and passerby rush to help Eyewitnesses said the incident occurred around 5 pm when Sujit was passing through the busy road. A kite string floating in the air suddenly wrapped around his neck. Within seconds, blood started flowing heavily. A woman passing by reacted quickly and rushed to his aid. She held his neck firmly and pressed the wound to slow the bleeding, preventing him from collapsing. Soon after, another passerby joined in and tied his handkerchief around Sujit’s neck to control the blood flow. Their timely intervention helped stabilise his condition and prevented a potentially fatal outcome. Injured youth reaches hospital on his own Despite the injury, Sujit remained calm and carefully got off his bike while keeping his neck straight. With help from people nearby, he stopped a passing auto-rickshaw and reached a nearby hospital. Doctors said his condition is stable and he is out of danger. Local residents said the quick response by bystanders saved his life. They added that any delay could have led to serious consequences. Banned kite string continues to pose threat The incident has once again raised concerns over the continued use and sale of banned Chinese manja in the city. This synthetic kite string, often coated with glass powder, is extremely sharp and can cause severe injuries. Several such accidents have been reported in Lucknow and other cities in recent years, especially during festivals and holidays when kite flying increases. Residents and pedestrians have demanded stricter enforcement to prevent the sale and use of prohibited manja. They urged the police and administration to conduct regular checks and take firm action against violators. Officials have repeatedly warned that banned kite strings pose a serious risk to motorcyclists, cyclists and pedestrians. Sunday’s incident serves as another reminder of the deadly danger posed by illegal kite strings on city roads.

stories.summary: Actor Sanjay Dutt arrived in Lucknow on Sunday and interacted with young fans during a road show, where he delivered a message on environmental conservation in his trademark Mumbai style. Addressing the crowd, Dutt said, “Oye mamu, listen up. All the mamus standing here, listen carefully. Do two things in life. First, plant trees. Second, save water. If you don’t do this, you’ll be in trouble.” His informal and energetic tone drew cheers from the audience, especially younger fans who gathered in large numbers to catch a glimpse of the actor. The road show was part of his visit to the city, where he greeted supporters and waved from an open vehicle. Dutt emphasised the importance of protecting natural resources, urging people to take responsibility for the environment. His message focused on simple but crucial actions such as planting trees and conserving water, which he said are essential for the future. The actor’s interaction quickly gained attention on social media, with videos of his remarks being widely shared. His use of colloquial language and signature style made the message more relatable to the crowd. Watch the video to see Sanjay Dutt’s full message to the youth in Lucknow

stories.title: Plan to construct BJP office on civic land proposed:Opposition councillors allege agenda was concealed; Lucknow civic body under fire
stories.summary: The Municipal Corporation has sent a proposal to the government to build the BJP headquarters on 58,534 square feet of land located in Jiamau, Lucknow. However, there is a snag in the rules regarding the land's lease deed. According to sources, the state BJP top leadership tried to resolve the rules by holding a meeting with LDA and Municipal Corporation officials, but the officials refused to make changes to the rules related to the lease deed. Congress and SP councilors claim that after the officials refused, the BJP started trying to solve the problem through the back door. On Saturday, a proposal related to the land for the BJP headquarters was secretly passed in the special session of the Municipal Corporation. Now it will be sent directly to the government for approval. Opposition councilors say that the agenda for the BJP headquarters was not received in the house, nor was it discussed. They are now also talking about a legal battle. Actually, a lease deed for the land located in Jiamau, where the BJP headquarters is being prepared to be built, was done in the year 2000 between the Municipal Corporation and Deendayal Seva Nyas. Under this, the organisation was supposed to build habitation, charitable facilities, and its office here. However, the secretary of Deendayal Seva Nyas has stated that only a community kitchen is to be built on this land. Now understand the whole matter in detail Land sought for BJP in the name of public service Now, Deendayal Seva Nyas is demanding to build a community kitchen on this land. After the kitchen is built, the institution proposes to bear its operational costs itself, so that work can be done in the public interest and the underprivileged can benefit from it. The institution has also demanded that the Bharatiya Janata Party be given the status of an associate organization, so that both can work together on the kitchen and office. This is the point that is bothering the opposition councillors. They say that as soon as this happens, BJP will build its office there. The institution has written a letter to Mayor Sushma Kharkwal, demanding to bring the Bharatiya Janata Party as an associate organization for the sub-lease of the land for building a community kitchen, office, and other social activities. They have also sought permission from the government and information about the payment amount. An NOC related to the land has also been requested. But the location of Jiamau seemed suitable Sources say that when land was being selected to build BJP's state headquarters in Lucknow, there were also several other plots in the city connected to the Municipal Corporation and LDA. Proposals were also made regarding them, but the BJP organization found the Giamau land most suitable, which is on the side of Lohia Path. Now know why the Municipal Corporation hid the proposal From the Mayor to the officials, everyone is avoiding speaking The entire process of acquiring land for BJP has been kept confidential. Therefore, only a few people in the municipal corporation were aware of the proposal related to it. In the house meeting, regarding the proposal related to the BJP office, from the Mayor to the Municipal Commissioner, Additional Municipal Commissioner, Property In-charge, and other officials, not a single word was spoken. The proposal was passed. Now, openly, no one is willing to say anything about the matter. Even after the proposal was passed by the house, SP and Congress councilors could not get information about it. On the spot, councilors said that no agenda was provided before the meeting. Even when the meeting started, the agenda related to the BJP office was not found. Now read what the councilors said Congress councilors said - will protest in the next house meeting Congress councilor Mukesh Singh Chauhan said - This is the first time that no agenda was received. Why is BJP so scared and intimidated? The proposal related to the BJP office did not come up in the house. Nor was there any discussion. This consensus is against the rules. We will protest against it in the next house meeting. Further legal battle is open. SP said - Why was it passed secretly? SP councilor Ram Naresh Chaurasia said - This is completely wrong. No such proposal has come up in the house. Nor has there been any discussion. I will raise this issue in the executive meeting of the municipal corporation as well. SP councilor Yayavar Hussain Reshu said - Why was this done secretly? This should be answered. The dignity of the municipal corporation's house has been tampered with. SP councilor party leader Kamran Beg said - The land of the municipal corporation should be for public service and not for any political party. A wrong tradition is being started.

stories.title: UP Assembly discusses Galgotia’s 'dog':University that was embarrassed AI Summit, has seen controversies earlier too
stories.summary: Galgotias University is embroiled in controversy for claiming a robotic dog as its invention during the AI Impact Summit 2026 in Delhi. By doing so, the university not only embarrassed itself but also the country. The entire stall of a large university like Galgotias was shut down. Even its lights were cut off. Later, the university also had to apologize. This matter was also raised in the UP Assembly. First, it was brought up by Engineer Sachin Yadav, MLA from Jasrana. Then, during the budget discussion, Leader of Opposition Mata Prasad Pandey also mentioned it. What is the whole controversy? Who said what in the Assembly? When has the university been embroiled in controversies before? When did Galgotias University get recognition? Who opposed it at that time? Read the answers to all these questions First, know the whole matter The AI Summit was underway at Bharat Mandapam in Delhi. Tech companies, startups, and institutions from around the world were showcasing their AI-related inventions. During this, a robotic dog placed in Galgotias University's pavilion became the center of attraction for people. Videos started being made, and clips quickly went viral on social media. Gradually, the claim began to spread that the university had created this robot. It was introduced by the name Orion. In some posts on the internet, its price was stated to be up to 350 crore. However, the reality was completely different. The university was ridiculed when an official Twitter handle from China claimed this robotic dog as its own. This revelation brought Galgotias University into controversy on social media. University's clarification was useless The controversy grew, and there was embarrassment. Immediately after this, Galgotias University issued a statement through a press release. It stated that the university never claimed to have built this robot. It is merely a model purchased from China for academic purposes, which students use for learning and experimentation. The university also acknowledged that a representative gave incorrect information on camera because she lacked technical knowledge. She was also not authorized to speak to the media. Nevertheless, she spoke, and the video went viral. They described it as a human error, not an institutional intent. The university also stated that their objective has always been to familiarize students with the world's advanced technology. Bringing technologies from countries like America, China, and Singapore to the campus does not mean importing technology, but rather giving students a global vision. What's special about the robotic dog? It is a consumer-level AI robot dog, which universities and research labs worldwide use for their students. This advanced robotic dog features technologies like readers, sensors, cameras, and AI-based motion control. This robot is a model from the Chinese company Unitree Robotics. Its name is Unitree Go2. It can be purchased online for $2800 (approximately 2.5 to 3 lakh rupees). SP raised the issue in the Assembly This matter was raised in the Assembly by Sachin Yadav, MLA from Jasrana Assembly seat of Firozabad, under a calling attention motion. He said that in the AI Impact Summit 2026, Galgotias University made a mockery of our state and our country before the entire world by claiming Chinese products as their own. This is not a political issue; it is a question of the integrity of the entire state. When our private universities are established, they work to defame our state's name on the national stage in this manner. They should be investigated, and action should be taken against them. This private university has played with the talent of youngsters. How did the product reach the AI Summit without verification? It is also somewhere the government's responsibility to work beyond just photo shoots. They should have verified whether the products or universities reaching the AI Summit are truly making their products through research. This responsibility should have been fixed. He demanded a thorough investigation into this matter. Strict action should be taken on this issue. So that no private university can take such a step in the future. Not degrees, but competence advances the country Another SP MLA, Pankaj Malik, had said on this very issue: Not degrees, but competence advances the country. Only true research determines the path of the future. So many students study in such a large university. The university is located in UP. Its accountability and monitoring fall within the purview of the state government. This incident raises questions about the future of our country. Pankaj Malik had said - We have very capable people here. A university that is a hub for making money cannot put a question mark on the future of our children. Pankaj Malik demanded that the entire matter be investigated impartially and in a timely manner. A clear factual description of the situation from the concerned university should be presented before the house. If found guilty, their recognition should be revoked. Mata Prasad had said - We had opposed the bill Leader of Opposition in the Assembly, Mata Prasad Pandey, said in his budget speech that universities charge so much fees. Take Galgotia University itself. Don't know, they brought a dog from somewhere and said they made it. When its bill came, I had opposed it, saying 'don't do this'. The number of universities you are giving out, these are not for the expansion of education. These are for increasing capitalists. This will lead to less growth in education, and their capital will increase more. He had demanded from Chief Minister Yogi to make a law for this. Fix the fees of an average school. Saint community divided over POCSO case against Shankaracharya:Ravindra Puri seeks punishment, Yogeshwari alleges tarnishing attempt
stories.summary: The POCSO court in Prayagraj has ordered the registration of an FIR against Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati over allegations of sexual exploitation involving two minor children. The directive follows a complaint raising serious accusations under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act. Following the court’s order, an FIR was registered late on February 21 at Jhunsi police station against the Shankaracharya and his disciple Mukundanand. The development has sparked intense debate within legal circles as well as among religious leaders, with sections of the saint community expressing sharply differing views on the matter. Timeline: from Magh Mela protest to FIR registration January 18, 2026: Swami Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati staged a protest during the Mauni Amavasya bathing ritual at the Magh Mela in Prayagraj after a confrontation with fair authorities over arrangements. His palanquin was pulled nearly one kilometre away from the Sangam, and its canopy was damaged. January 24, 2026: Ashutosh Brahmachari Maharaj approached Jhunsi police station with two minor batuks and alleged sexual exploitation and misconduct by the Shankaracharya. Police did not register an FIR at the time. February 8, 2026: After no police action, the complainant moved the POCSO court. The complaint alleged that minors were made to work, raised suspicion of sexual exploitation, and accused the Shankaracharya of using fake letterheads. February 10, 2026: Representatives of the Shankaracharya dismissed the allegations, calling them a political conspiracy. February 21, 2026: Acting on the court’s directive, Jhunsi police registered an FIR against Swami Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati and his disciple Mukundanand under relevant provisions concerning sexual exploitation of minors. After FIR registration: Responding to the court’s order, Swami Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati said, “A false case will not become true.” Saint community calls for investigation, restraint, and fairness The allegations have triggered varied reactions from religious leaders across akhadas and saint organisations, reflecting both support for due process and concern over reputational damage to religious institutions. Sanjana Giri, Mahamandaleshwar of the Kinnar Akhada, emphasised the significance of the Shankaracharya position. “Shankaracharya is not an ordinary designation. It is one of the highest and most revered positions in Sanatan Dharma. Some people are presenting the matter in a political light, which raises questions,” she said. She also questioned the timing of the allegations. “If there was an objection, why did it not emerge earlier? Allegations surfacing only after the Magh Mela create suspicion. However, the law of the country applies equally to all.” Mahant Narayan Giri of the Juna Akhada said the truth would emerge only after investigation. “Whether the allegations are true or false can only be established through proper inquiry. Until then, conclusions should not be drawn,” he said. He also criticised public statements made by the Shankaracharya against Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. “Such remarks do not suit someone holding such a respected position,” he added. Mahamandaleshwar Yog Yogeshwari Yati of the Juna Akhada said the sudden emergence of allegations was unusual. “Until now, no such allegations had surfaced. The fact that they have appeared suddenly raises questions. The investigation must establish the truth,” she said. Akhada Parishad and religious bodies stress rule of law Akhil Bharatiya Akhada Parishad president Ravindra Puri said the matter should be handled strictly as per law. “If the allegations are proven true, the guilty must be punished. If they are false, action must be taken against those who made them,” he said. He added that the Shankaracharya position carries immense responsibility. “It would be premature to comment on the truth of the allegations at this stage. Some statements from minors have emerged, but their validity must be examined through investigation.” Mahant Ratan Giri, secretary of Shri Niranjani Panchayati Akhada, said restraint was necessary. “We are monitoring developments, but it would be inappropriate to comment until the investigation progresses. It is important to wait for verified facts,” he said. Swami Ramnarayan of Shri Shani Shanti Dham in Mishrauli Dham urged caution in public discourse. “Speaking about saints requires dignity and restraint. Saints too must uphold dignity in their conduct and statements,” he said. Tapaswi Chhavni’s head priest, Jagadguru Paramhans Acharya, echoed similar sentiments. “Until guilt is proven, it is not appropriate to reach conclusions. If the allegations are proven true, it will deeply impact the image of the saint community,” he said. Sant Samiti calls allegations serious, urges impartial probe Swami Jitendranand Saraswati, general secretary of the Akhil Bharatiya Sant Samiti, described the matter as serious and called for an impartial investigation. “This is not an ordinary case. The statements of minor children have been recorded before a judge. Such matters should not be viewed through political lenses. The law must be allowed to take its course,” he said. He also pointed to past cases involving prominent religious figures. “If allegations in cases involving Asaram and Ram Rahim were proven through investigation, then the allegations in this case too must be examined fairly. The law does not discriminate,” he said. Allegations and counter-allegations deepen divisions While some religious leaders have questioned the motives behind the complaint, others have emphasised the importance of due process and impartial investigation. Some saints expressed concern that politically motivated allegations could damage the global reputation of Sanatan Dharma. Others maintained that the seriousness of allegations involving minors requires careful legal scrutiny rather than dismissal. The complainant, Ashutosh Brahmachari, was seen leaving court in tears earlier this month after pursuing legal action. Investigation underway, legal process begins Police have confirmed that an FIR has been registered against Swami Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati and his disciple Mukundanand in connection with allegations involving minor children. The case will now proceed through investigation under relevant POCSO provisions. Authorities are expected to record statements, collect evidence, and determine whether charges will be formally filed in court. As the legal process unfolds, the case has highlighted deep divisions within the saint community while underscoring the broader principle repeatedly invoked by religious leaders themselves — that the law applies equally to all, regardless of position or stature.

stories.title: Security tightened after threats to judge in Bijnor court:Convicts warn ADJ of revenge; police tightened security at court premises
stories.summary: In Bijnor, convicts sentenced to life imprisonment allegedly threatened an Additional District and Sessions Judge, accusing him of injustice and warning that they knew the location of his village and home. Following the incident, police escorted the judge home under protection, according to the government advocate. After receiving the threat, ADJ Nijendra Kumar wrote to the administration, the DGP, the District Judge, and other senior officials, seeking security arrangements in court. Police have since tightened security at the court premises. The incident occurred on May 19, 2024, when Pukhraj Singh, a resident of Matora Durga village in the Dhampur police station area, was working in his field. A car stopped near him, and its occupants allegedly dragged him onto the road before running him over, killing him on the spot. People working in nearby fields rushed to the scene after hearing the commotion and identified Jaideep, Pintu Chauhan, and Rishipal, residents of Shivala Kala, as being in the car. Jaideep, who was serving in the Army and posted at the Army Headquarters in Delhi, was among the accused. Pukhraj’s daughter Renu lodged a complaint at the Dhampur police station. Acting on the report, police arrested the accused and, after investigation, filed a chargesheet in court against Jaideep and Pintu Chauhan for Pukhraj’s murder. Daughter said - Father was killed for pursuing the case In court, Pukhraj's daughter Anjali stated that she was married to the accused Jaydeep's brother Pradeep. Her in-laws harassed her over dowry demands, against which she had filed several cases. Her father, Pukhraj Singh, used to pursue these cases. The accused killed her father due to this enmity. CO escorted judge home under security ADJ Nijendra Kumar's court had sentenced Jaydeep Chauhan and Pintu Chauhan to life imprisonment on Thursday after finding them guilty. In anger, both threatened to kill ADJ Nijendra Kumar. After this, CO City arrived at the scene with force. After the court closed, they escorted the ADJ to his residence. Assistant Government Advocate Ajit Pawar said - After pronouncing the sentence, Jaydeep and Pintu Chauhan threatened the judge, saying that you have done an injustice. We know your village and house address. We won't spare you. After this, both went to the lockup while abusing and misbehaving.

stories.summary: Noida STF killed ₹50,000 reward shooter, Pawan Gurjar alias Kallu, in an encounter in Agra. The 35-year-old shooter carried a ₹50,000 bounty and had 18 serious cases registered against him. He had earlier snatched a 9mm pistol from a constable. The criminal had connections with the Randeep Bhati and Amit Kasana gang. A large quantity of weapons and ammunition was recovered from him. The encounter took place in the Ekta police station area. The criminal was identified as Pawan alias Kallu, son of Santram, resident of Sirouli, Loni police station, Ghaziabad. He was wanted in an extortion case registered at Tajganj police station in Agra Commissionerate. A reward of ₹50 thousand was announced for him. Police said - In 2021, a reward of ₹1 lakh was announced for Pawan in a murder case. During that time, he was arrested in Delhi and sent to jail. Pawan is a shooter of the notorious Randeep Bhati - Amit Kasana gang. He has 4 murder cases, 2 extortion cases, and more than 18 criminal cases registered against him in total. During his stay in jail, Pawan came in contact with the Himanshu Bhau gang, notorious in Haryana. After being released from jail in 2025, he started demanding extortion money on a large scale. Was planning a big crime Police officials say that the accused was planning to carry out major criminal incidents in Delhi and Western Uttar Pradesh. A large quantity of cartridges and illegal weapons have been recovered from him. Police are taking further legal action in the case. Pistol was snatched from ADJ’s PSO Additional SP Rajkumar Mishra of Noida STF said that a 9MM pistol was recovered from the spot during the encounter. The weapon had been snatched in 2016 from Constable Monu Dhiman in Bisrakh, Gautam Buddh Nagar. At the time, Constable Dhiman was deployed on PSO duty for an ADJ. A case in connection with the incident is registered at Bisrakh police station.

stories.title: Moid Khan released from jail after 19 months:Says, 'Yogi is a saint, MLA misled'; acquitted in gang rape case
stories.summary: Ayodhya's controversial gang rape case SP leader Moid Khan has been released from jail. He came out of jail on Friday after 19 months. He told the media, I had faith in the judiciary. We have got justice. Moid Khan said, CM Yogi is a saint. He cannot do this kind of work. The Chief Minister was misled by false news. The Bikapur MLA (Amit Singh Chauhan) misled the CM by giving wrong information. The MLA did not tell any correct facts. That's why action was taken against us. The SP leader said that if CM Yogi's blessings remain, the bakery will be built again. This is a means of employment for our children. POCSO court judge Nirupama Vikram acquitted Moid Khan on January 29. Now, the SP leader has also got bail under the Gangster Act. His servant Raju Khan was found guilty and sentenced to 20 years. Some people from our community did this out of revenge SP leader Moid Khan said that some people from our own community did this work out of revenge. We did not face any inconvenience in jail. We were well taken care of in jail. Our children's livelihood was running from the bakery. Some people from our own society could not see this. Our Chief Minister has no fault in this incident. The SP leader also said, Wrong has been done with the girl, there is no doubt about this. People had taught the girl and her mother. Moeed's servant's DNA came positive A gangrape report was filed with a minor girl in Purakalandar on July 29, 2024. SP leader Moid Khan and his bakery worker Raju Khan were made accused in this. During the police investigation, DNA tests were conducted on Moid Khan and his servant Raju Khan. In the report, Moid Khan's DNA came negative, while Raju Khan's DNA was positive. After examining the DNA report and other evidence, the court acquitted Moid. Meanwhile, servant Raju Khan was sentenced to 20 years. Moid got advantage on 4 points in court Saeed Khan, the lawyer defending Moid, told a media channel that the DNA test results were most crucial in this decision. The court has considered Moid innocent and 'honorably acquitted' him. 1. DNA test of the fetus was done on the court's order, which did not match with Moid's DNA. 2. The prosecution could not even prove where the incident took place. The prosecution presented a total of 13 witnesses in support of the rape victim. 3. It was also claimed that a video was made during the incident, but no video was presented as evidence in court. 4. Contradictions have also emerged regarding the crime scene in the police investigation. In the police investigation, separate claims were made about the incident occurring under a tree outside the bakery and inside the bakery. Bulldozer was run on Moid's bakery and complex After this case came to light, the administration had also carried out bulldozer action on Moid Khan's bakery and shopping complex. This had created a political controversy at that time. After the court's decision, Moid Khan's supporters and family members got major relief.
